tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /rje btsun 'jam pa'i rdo rje mngon par rtogs pa bzhugs/ dpa' gsang ba 'dus pa ye shes zhabs kyi lugs so// na mo mañju badz+ra ya/ dpal gsang ba 'dus pa 'jam pa'i rdo rje'i mngon par rtogs pa 'dod rgu'i rgya mtsho zhes bya ba/ 'phangs pa ngag gi dbang phyug la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dpal ldan dge legs rin chen bye ba'i rdul brtsegs mchog /yon tan sku bzhi rim par brtsegs pa'i dpal 'bar ba/ /bde chen stong nyid chu gter dbus na brtan gnas shing / /rgyal ba gser ri'i dbus na gzi 'bar 'jam dbyangs rgyal/ /khyab bdag mchog de dpal ldan 'dus pa yi/ /lam gyis tshe 'di nyid la sgrub pa'i thabs/ /de sras sangs rgyas ye shes zhabs kyis ni/ /ji ltar bzhed bzhin sgrub pa 'dir bshad bya/ /'jam pa'i dbyangs dang mi gnyis shing / /rgyal ba kun gyi dge legs rnams/ /gcig bsdus bla ma mchog rnams kyis/ /slar yang srid mtha'i bar du skyongs/ /ma lus phan bde'i rin chen 'byung gnas mchog /tsha bas mi dmangs bsrung pa'i gdengs can dbang / /tshangs dang me lha'i gdong lag mthu ldan sogs/ /las byed de dag don 'dir ci mi 'bad/ /de yang zung 'jug yan lag bdun ldan gyi go 'phangs sgrub par byed pa'i thabs kyi yan lag yongs su rdzogs pa ni rnal 'byor bla na med pa'i lam yin la/ de yang spang bya skye shi bar do gsum gyis gtso bor bsdus pa'i nyes skyon mtha' dag gnyen po don dam 'od gsal dang / kun rdzob sgyu lus te/ mnyam bzhag gis sems dang lus gnyis dang / rjes thob kyis gzhan don te/ gsum gyis sbyangs pa'i 'bras bu chos longs sprul pa'i sku gsum myur du sgrub par byed pa yin zhing / lam la skye rdzogs gnyis kyi spang bya spong byed dang 'bras bu sgrub byed dngos ni rdzogs pa'i rim pa yin la/ de'i smin byed phul du byung ba ni bskyed pa'i rim pa yin no/ /zhes bya ba ni bla med kyi lam spyi'i snying po bsdus pa'o/

/de yang slob dpon nag po spyod pas bde mchog gi rdzogs rim du/ dpal ldan 'dus pa'i lam 'di ni/ /rgyud rnams kun gsungs gtso bo ste/ /rim pa gnyis ka'i ngo bo la/ /dpal ldan 'dus pa lhag yid 'ong / /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ dpal gsang ba 'dus pa nyid rim gnyis kyi gnad gzhan las rmad du byung ba yin no/ /'di la slob dpon chen po klu sgrub kyis bshad rgyud rdo rje phreng ba gtso bor mdzad pa'i bskyed rdzogs kyi rnam bzhag gcig dang / slob dpon sangs rgyas ye shes zhabs kyis rje btsun 'jam pa'i dbyangs la dngos su zhus pa/ gtso cher rtsa rgyud la brten nas mdzad pa'i rnam bzhag gcig ste/ gsang 'dus lugs gnyis su rgya bod gnyis na nyi zla ltar grags la/ de la rgya gar gyi phyis kyi paṇa grub tshad ldan mtha' dag gis lugs phyi ma gtso bor mdzad de/ slob dpon nag po spyod pa'i bde mchog gi mngon rtogs dang / bram ze dpal 'dzin la sogs pas mdzad pa'i gshin rje gshed kyi skor mtha' dag la sogs pa'i bla med kyi sgrub thabs phal che ba zhig lugs 'di'i bskyed rim gyi 'gros la rten pa yin la/ khyad par kha che rin chen rdo rjes mdzad pa'i gsang 'dus mi bskyod pa dang / jo bo rjes mdzad pa'i 'jig rten dbang phyug gnyis ni 'di'i sgrub thabs kun bzang gi tshig bcad tshig lhug tu dkrol ba'i tshul gyis bsgyur zhing / rin chen rdo rjes ni/ slob dpon sangs rgyas ye shes zhabs kyis mdzad pa'i sgrub thabs kun tu bzang por grags pa las kyang cung zad kha bkang ste mdzad do/ /de yang lugs 'di'i bskyed rim gyi chings ni/ yan lag drug dang rnal 'byor bzhi la sogs pa'i tha snyad mi mdzad kyi/ gsang 'dus kyi rgyud phyi ma dang dus 'khor nas 'byung ba'i bsnyen bsgrub yan lag bzhi dang ting nge 'dzin gnyis dang rnal 'byor gnyis kyis bsdus la/ ting nge 'dzin gnyis ni dang po sbyor ba dang dkyil 'khor rgyal mchog gi ting nge 'dzin no/

/rnal 'byor gnyis ni/ thig le dang phra mo'i rnal 'byor ro/ /mdor na de lta bu'i bskyed rim dang rdzogs rim ston pa'i ye shes zhabs kyi gzhung dang / de'i dngos slob mar me mdzad bzang po'i dkyil mchog bzhi brgya lnga bcu pa rnams la tshad mar byas nas de'i rjes su mi 'brang ba'i mkhas pa ni su yang med do/ /de'i phyir lugs 'di ni 'bad pa chen pos brtsal te nan tan chen pos bzung zhing rgyas par bya ba'i lam srol zla med pa yin pas bdag legs su 'dod pa rnams kyis lugs 'di la gtso bor bya'o/ /de ltar na 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyi sgrub thabs 'di nyams su blang pa la don gsum ste/ sngon 'gro dang / dngos gzhi dang / 'jug go /dang po la ring ba'i dang / nye ba'i sngon 'gro gnyis so/ /dang po ni/ 'di'i sgrub thabs kun bzang las/ dal 'byor 'di ni shin tu g.yo ba dang / /'jig rten skye bo dam pa phrad rnyed dka'/ /de bas shes rab thabs la gzhol ba yis/ /yid la byed pa'i mchog de bsgrub par bya/ /de la sngags pas snying rje'i stobs kyis ni/ /byang chub mchog gi sems ni brtan po dang / /zhes sogs legs par gsungs pa ltar dal 'byor rnyed dka' ba la sogs pa'i lam thun mong ba rnams kyis rgyud legs par sbyangs pa'i gang zag dbang po mchog tu gyur pas/ dkyil chog bzhi brgya lnga bcu pa nas gsungs pa ltar mtshan nyid dang ldan pa'i bla ma mchog las 'di'i dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur ba dang rjes su gnang ba thob nas/ lhag pa'i lha la mchog tu dad pas/ de'i go 'phangs sems can gyi don du myur du sgrub par 'dod pas/ la lar dri med chu ni phun tshogs shing / /shing mchog mdzes pas rnam par brgyan pa yi/ /ri bo'i phyogs gcig tu ni bcom ldan 'das/ /'jam pa'i dbyangs zhes bya ba sgrub par bya/ /zhes gsungs pa lta bu'i gnas su/ tsan+dan bzang po la sogs kyis byugs shing / /dri zhim me tog cal dkral mchog gi cha'i/

/bsam gtan gnas su bde ba'i mal stan la/ /zhes sogs dang mthun pa'i gnas khang dang yo byad la sogs pa dngos su 'byor pa'am/ med na mos pas tho rangs stan bde ba la kha shar du phyogs pas skyil mo krung gis 'dug ste/ rang nyid skad cig gis 'jam pa'i rdo rjer gsal ba'i thugs khar zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du maṃ yig dmar ser 'od zer rab tu 'bar ba'i snang ba chen pos rang gi sgo gsum gyi dri ma sbyangs shing phyir 'phros pas gdan gsum tshang ba'i dbang lha thams cad spyan drangs te 'od zer chen pos dbang bskur ba ltar rang la khrus gsol zhing dbang skur bar gyur/ zhes brjod cing bsam par byas la kha dang gdong la sogs pa bkru ba dngos sam der mos par bya'o/ /de nas thun mtshams kyi lha gsal btab ste yo byad byin gyis rlob pa'i phyir du/ rang nyid 'jam pa'i rdo rje sku mdog dmar ser ser sngo dkar ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug gi dang po gnyis rang 'dra'i yum 'jam pa'i rdo rje ma la 'khyud cing / lhag ma g.yas gnyis la gri dang mda'/ g.yon gnyis ut+pal dang gzhu 'dzin pa/ rin po che'i rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan cing dar sna tshogs kyi na bza' can du gyur/ de nas nang mchod byin gyis rlob tshul la/ deng sang gi gang zag 'ga' zhig phyis kyi mkhas pa chen po blo bzang grags pa'i dpal gyis mdzad pa'i sngags kyi lam rim nas bdud rtsi bskyed chog gsungs pa de spyi 'gro yin par byas nas lugs 'di la'ang sha lnga bdud rtsi lnga ste rdzas bcu ka bskyed pa ni mi rigs te/ de lta na gsang dus 'phags lugs la'ang rdo rje phreng bar bshad pa sngags rim du bkod pa de nyid byed rigs pa'i skyon du'ang 'gyur la/ 'dir sgrub thabs kun bzang dang kun tu bzang mo gnyis/ bzhi brgya lnga bcu pa rtsa 'grel/ rin chen rdo rje/ jo bo rje la sogs pa sus kyang sha lnga ma bshad pa'i phyir ro/ /des na 'gro mgon 'phags pas rdzas bcu bskyed pa'ang mi rigs so/

/de yang sgrub thabs kyi gtso bo gnyis las ni bdud rtsi lnga la rigs lnga'i sa bon gyis mtshan par bshad pa tsam las med la/ dkyil chog bzhi brgya lnga bcu par/ zla ba nyi ma cha sman dri/ /zhes byang sems dang / rak+ta dang / dri chu dang / sman sha chen dang / dri chen rnams gsungs so/ /de ltar na 'di skad ces brjod cing bsams te/ oṃ āḥbi ghān+ta kṛta hūm̐/ oṃ shū n+ya tā dz+nyā na badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3 haṃ/ stong pa nyid du gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las yaṃ las rlung gi dkyil 'khor sngon po gzhu'i dbyibs can rgyal mtshan la yaṃ gyis mtshan pa/ de'i steng du raṃ las me'i dkyil 'khor dmar po gru gsum pa raṃ gyis mtshan pa/ de'i steng du kaṃ las mi mgo'i sgyed bu gsum gyi steng du a las thod pa phyi dkar la nang dmar ba dpral ba rang la bstan pa yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang gi shar du bh+rūm̐ las dri chen bh+rūm̐ gyis mtshan pa/ lhor am̐ las rak+ta am̐ gis mtshan pa/ nub tu dz+rīṃ las byang sems dz+rīṃ gis mtshan pa/ byang du kham̐ las sha chen kham̐ gis mtshan pa/ dbus su hūm̐ las dri chu hūm̐ gis mtshan pa/ thun mong gi steng du oṃ yig dkar po 'od zer 'phro bar gyur/ rang gi thugs kha'i maṃ gyi 'od zer gyis de bzhin gshegs pa rigs lnga spyan drangs te rang rang gi sa bon la thim zhing rlung g.yos te me sbar bas rdzas rnams zhu zhing khol/ dri ma thams cad sbyangs shing kha dog dmar ser nyi ma 'char ka'i mdog can gsal zhing dwangs par gyur/ de'i rlangs pa gyen du phyur ba las byung ba'i hūm̐ las rdo rje dkar po rtse lnga pa 'od zer rab tu 'phro ba gsum yang bar snang de nyid du zhu ba thod par lhung pas ye shes kyi bdud rtsi zag pa med pa'i ro dang bcud kyis brgyan par byas/ oṃ yig gi 'od zer gyis phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten na gnas pa'i snod bcud kyi bdud rtsi thams cad bkug nas stim pas rgya cher spel zhing byin gyis rlabs par gyur/

'bru gsum brjod/ 'di yang jo bo dang rin chen rdo rje sogs dang cung zad mi mthun yang slob dpon nyid kyis kun tu bzang mo gtso bor byas pa'o/ /de nas legs par bshams pa'i mchod rdzas rnams/ snga ma ltar bsang zhing sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las a las byung pa'i thod pa yangs shing rgya che ba rnams kyi nang du aṃ paṃ aṃ puṃ la sogs pa mchod rdzas so so'i ming yig dang po thig les brgyan pa zhu ba las byung ba'i mchod yon zhabs bsil zhal bsil/ me tog bdug spos mar me dri mchog zhal zas rol mo la sogs pa'i mchod rdzas thams cad/ rang bzhin bde stong gi ye shes/ rnam pa mchod rdzas kyi sprin spungs/ byed las rang gzhan gyi dbang po mtha' dag zag med kyi bde bas tshim par byed pas phyi nang kun tu gang bar gyur/ oṃ ar+ghaṃ āḥhūm̐/ de bzhin du/ pā d+yaṃ/ āñca ma ṇaṃ/ puṣ+pe/ dhū pe/ ā lo ke/ gan+dhe/ nai wi d+ye/ shab+da/ rū pa/ shab+da/ gan+dha/ ra sa/ spar+sha/ dha rma dhā tu/ āḥhūm̐/ badz+ra s+pha ra ṇa khaṃ/ zhes brjod cing bsam ste/ chu gsum yang gzhung de nyid las 'byung ngo / /de nas sngon 'gro'i gtor ma byed na yang / dgos su mchod gtor bshams pa sngar ltar byin gyis rlabs la/ gsang 'dus 'phags lugs mi bskyod pa'i phyogs skyong gi gtor chog da lta grags che ba 'di/ slob dpon a bha yas rdo rje phreng bar gsungs pa yin la/ phreng ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo 'jam rdor yin pas/ rang gi thugs kha'i hūm̐ gi dod du maṃ dmar ser gyis 'od zer 'phros pas zhes pa bcug pa nyid kyis 'grub la/ yang na bu ston rin po ches 'di'i dkyil chog tu phyogs skyong bcu la 'bul bar gsungs pa ltar byed na/ rang gi thugs kha'i maṃ las 'od zer 'phros pas phyogs skyong bcu 'khor dang bcas pa spyan drangs nas phyogs bcur 'khod pa ni/ shar du brgya byin ser po glang chen la zhon pa rdo rje 'dzin pa/ shar lhor me lha dmar po ra skyes la zhon pa bgrang phreng 'dzin pa/

lhor gshin rje sngon po ma he la zhon pa dbyug tho 'dzin pa/ lho nub tu srin po nag po ro langs la zhon pa ral gri 'dzin pa/ nub tu chu lha dkar po chu srin la zhon pa sprul zhags 'dzin pa/ nub byang du rlung lha ljang sngon ri dwags la zhon pa ba dan 'dzin pa/ byang du gnod sbyin ser po rta la zhon pa ne'u le 'dzin pa/ byang shar du dbang ldan dkar po khyu mchog la zhon pa rtse gsum 'dzin pa/ steng du tshangs pa ser po ngang pa la zhon pa 'khor lo 'dzin pa/ 'og tu sa lha ser mo pad+ma la gnas pa pad+ma 'dzin pa rnams skad cig gis 'od gsal du bcug pa las 'dus pa'i lha shes rab ma dang bcas pa'i skur bzhengs pa'i mgron rnams kyi ljags hūm̐ las skyes pa'i rdo rje rtse gcig pa dmar po 'od kyi sbu gu can rnams su gyur/ oṃ āḥhrīḥpra wa raṃ/ sat+ka raṃ/ ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha hūm̐ swā hā/ de bzhin du/ pā d+yaṃ/ āñca ma ṇaṃ pra tīts+tsha hūm̐ swā hā/ oṃ in+da/ ag+ni/ ya ma/ nai ra t+ye/ wā ru ṇa/ wā ya bya/ ku be ra/ ī shā na/ brah+ma/ pri thī wī de wī swā hā/ oṃ a kā ro mu khaṃ sarba dharmā ṇāṃ ād+ya nut+pan+na twā ta/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ zhes pa gsum gyis phul/ dril bu bsil zhing / khams gsum gnas pa'i lha dang klu/ /gnod sbyin dri za lha ma yin/ /gang dag rdzu 'phrul cher ldan zhing / /rdo rje'i spyan dang snyan mnga' ba/ /sa la gnas pa'i 'byung po rnams/ /bdag la dgongs par mdzad du gsol/ /bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi ba yis/ /sangs rgyas rnams la mchod pa dang / /sems can rnams la phan don du/ /sa phyogs dge gnas 'di nyid du/ /dam pa'i dkyil 'khor cher 'byung ba/ /ji ltar bsam pa'i las byed na/ /khyed kyis bar chad ma byed par/ /dge ba'i grogs po nyid du mdzod/ /oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe pra tīts+tsha hūm̐ swā hā/ /de bzhin du/ dhū pe nas shab+da'i bar brjod/ da sha dika lo ka pā la oṃ āḥhūm̐/ ma rnyed yongs su ma shes dang /

/gang yang nus pa ma mchis pas/ /'dir ni bya ba gang bgyis pa/ /de kun khyed rnams bzod mdzad rigs/ /yig brgya brjod/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ badz+ra muḥ'ajig rten pa rnams rang gnas su gshegs par gyur/ de nas sgrub mchod dang 'brel na gsol gdab maṇ+ḍal 'bul ba sogs spyi dang mthun/ skyabs 'gro sems bskyed/ 'og nas 'byung ba'i yid kyi rol pa nas byang chub dam pa bskyed par bgyi'i bar lan gsum brjod/ yig brgya'i bzlas brjod byed pa'ang spyi dang mthun no/ /gnyis pa nye ba'i sngon 'gro la mthun rkyen sgrub pa tshogs gnyis bsags pa dang / 'gal rkyen 'gog pa srung 'khor bsgom pa'o/ /dang po la ni/ gang dag bsod nams kyi tshogs kyi skabs su tshad med pa bzhi mi bsgom pa ni/ kun tu bzang mo las tshad med bzhi rgyas par bsgom tshul gsungs pa dang 'gal zhing phyag 'tshal mi byed pa ni jo bo chen po gsung dang mi mthun no/ /des na rang nyid 'jam pa'i rdo rjer gsal ba'i thugs khar zla ba'i dkyil 'khor dri ma med pa la gnas pa'i maṃ yig dmar ser rnam thar sgo gsum gyi rang bzhin/ yid bzhin gyi nor bu ltar 'jig rten gyi dbul ba sel bar byed pa las 'od zer dpag tu med pa 'phros te bsod nams kyi tshogs mtha' yas pa myur du sgrub pa'i phyir du/ 'od kyi sna la rtsa ba'i bla ma rigs kyi bdag po'i rnam par bzhugs pa'i dpal ldan 'dus pa 'jam pa'i rdo rje'i dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' thams cad bsdus pa'i bdag nyid mdun gyi nam mkhar spyan drangs/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga tā kā ya wāka tsit+taṃ pra ṇa mya badz+ra ban dhā nāṃ ka ro mi/ dpal ldan mi shes kun spangs dri med gzi brjid ldan/ /dpag med rigs kyi sprul pa rnams kyis rab brgyan zhing / /shes rab yan lag 'dus pa 'bar zhing rab mdzes pa/ /'jam dpal gang de mchod phyir de la phyag 'tshal lo/ /oṃ bha ga wān mañja badz+ra dā+e ba tsakra maṇ+ḍa la sa pa ri wā ra ar+ghaṃ pū dza me gha sa mu dra sma ra ṇa sa ma ya shrī hūm̐/

de bzhin du 'dir/ pā d+yaṃ/ puṣ+pe/ dhū pe/ ā lo ke/ gan+dhe/ nai wi d+ye/ shap+ta/ rū pa/ gan+dha/ ra sa/ s+phar+sha dharma dhā tu badz+ra rnams sbyar ro/ /gang zhig thog med srid pa'i chu klung du/ /ma lus kun rtog gis bsags rnyog pa rnams/ /thugs rje che ldan spyan sngar de dag ni/ /cho ga bzhin du thams cad gshegs par bgyi/ /rdzogs sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' dang / /'phags pa gzhan gyis dge ba gang mdzad pa/ /de dag kun la yang dag yi rang zhing / /byang chub tu ni yongs su bsngo bar bgyi/ /yid kyi rol pa dri med zla 'dras sgrubs/ /snying rje dam pa mtha' yas pa yi thabs/ /rang gi yid la gnas par gyur pa yi/ /bde gshegs rnams la rtag tu skyabs su mchi/ /rtog pa ma lus pa las nges grol zhing / /sems dpa' dam pa rnams kyi phun tshogs gzhi/ /dngos po thams cad ro cig ngo bo nyid/ /dam pa'i chos la rtag tu skyabs su mchi/ /'ching ba rnams las nges par grol gyur cing / /snying rje mchog gis bskrun pa'i dpal dang ldan/ /rab tu dga' sogs sa la rab bzhugs pa'i/ /brtul zhugs dbang po'i tshogs la skyabs su mchi/ /bsam dang rnam par smin pa dag gyur pas/ /sgrib pa kun gyi bag chags yang dag 'byin/ /lhag par mos pas rnam par brgyan pa yi/ /sems ni byang chub ngan pa bskyed par bgyi/ /bde gshegs sras bcas rnams kyi lam cig pu/ /sbyin sogs rnam bcu dkar po'i yon tan tshul/ /rdzogs sangs rgyas bdag ma lus ngo bo'i blos/ /yang dag nyid du da ni gnas par bgyi'o/ /sems can thams cad bde ba dang bde ba'i rgyu dang ldan par gyur cig sdug bsngal dang sdug bsngal gyi rgyu dang bral bar gyur cig bdag gis sems can thams cad bde ba dang ldan zhing sdug bsngal dang bral ba'i don du 'jam pa'i rdo rje thob par 'gyur ro/ /rang gzhan thams cad 'jig rten gyi chos brgyad mgo snyoms pa'i btang snyoms la gnas par bgyi'o/

/zhes don dran bzhin pas brjod do/ /rang gzhan snod bcud kyis bsdus pa'i chos thams cad kyi ngo bo rgyu 'bras gsum rang bzhin gyis grub pas stong pa'i stong pa nyid du gyur par nges par bya zhing / khyad par rin chen rdo rjes gong gi mchod bya mchod byed bshags bya bshags byed la sogs pa thams cad la bden stong gi lta bas rgyas 'debs pa'i bsam pas/ ngo bo nyid dang bral phyir stong pa ste/ /rang bzhin rgyu dang bral bas mtshan ma med/ /rtog pa rnams dang bral phyir dngos rnams kun/ /ma lus smon pa las ni nges par grol/ /oṃ shū n+yā tā dz+nyā na badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3 haṃ/ zhes brjod do/ /kha cig na re 'dir bden stong gi lta ba bskyangs pa'i sgo nas gong 'og gi rnal 'byor thams cad de'i rtsis zin par byed pa yin gyi/ snang ba bsdud pa ma yin zhing de'i phyi bskyed rim gyi lam gyi gnad sku gsum lam khyer gyi 'chi ba chos skur 'khyer ba'i lam du byed pa yang mi bde ste/ 'di dang 'og gi srung 'khor la sogs pa rnams bskyed rim gyi sbyor ba ma yin par 'gyur ba'i phyir ro/ /zhes zer ba ni 'thad par ma mthong ste/ dus 'khor dang gsang 'dus 'phags lugs dang bde mchog sogs la de ltar bden mod kyang / 'dir ni sgrub thabs kun bzang las gong gi tshig bcad sngags dang bcas pa las gzhan pa'i 'chi ba chos skur 'khyer ba'i lam cung zad kyang ma gsungs la/ kun tu bzang mor 'di'i skabs su bar srid nam mkhar 'jog pa rgyu mtshan dang bcas nas gsungs pa'i phyir ro/ /des na lugs 'di la bar do mtshon byed ni/ 'og rgyu rdo rje 'dzin pa la bar srid 'jug pa'i skabs nyid du/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ zhes bya ba'i sems nyid ni/ 'od ldan ho dang spel ba cho ga bzhin/ /zhes kun bzang las gsungs pa ltar/ 'di'i dngos kyi rjes 'brang thams cad kyis kyang skabs der bshad la/ dang por gang du 'jog gi bshad pa ni kun tu bzang mo las gzhan du gsal po cung zad kyang mi 'byung ngo /

/de'i rgyu mtshan gyis 'chi srid sbyong byed kyang mi gsal mod kyi/ srung 'khor gyi 'og tu lhag mos 'od gsal du bsdud pa dang / phung sogs dang 'byung ba rnams rim gyis thim pa dang / he ru ka'i don bdag med gnyis sgom pa lta bu med pa rnams la ni srung 'khor gyi sngon gyi ye shes kyi tshogs nyid 'chi srid sbyong byed du rigs pa dang lung 'dis grub bo/ /spyir ye shes kyi tshogs bskyed rim gyi sbyor ba yin pa tsam gyis 'chi srid sbyong byed du mi 'dod na ni bde mchog lo hi pa dang dus 'khor lta bu la'ang der 'gyur ro/ /des na skabs 'dir rnal 'byor pa'i lus kyi 'byung ba thim rim sogs dngos su med kyang / mnyam bzhag gi ngor snang ba mtha' dag bsdus pa'i 'od gsal de nyid 'chi srid sbyong byed du byas na ni skye gnas mtha' dag gi 'chi srid sbyong bar nus kyi/ 'byung ba thim rim dngos su yod pa'i 'od gsal gyis ni mngal skyes kyi 'chi srid las gzhan pa sbyong bar mi nus pas lugs de ni khams drug 'dus 'dzam bu gling pa'i mngal skyes kho na'i lam du gsungs so/ /des na gnyis pa ni/ 'di skad ces bya ste/ stong pa'i ngang las kun rdzob kyi snang ba thams cad 'dod pa tsam dang 'brel ba'i gzhi med du rtogs par bya ba'i phyir du/ nam mkha'i khams su a las byung ba'i zla ba'i dkyil 'khor shin tu gsal ba'i dbus su rang gi bar do'i lus ngag yid gsum gyi ngo bo oṃ dkar po/ āḥdamar po/ hūm̐ sngon po rnams thabs shes chags sems kyi rang bzhin ho dmar po gnyis kyi dbus na 'khod pa me long gi gzugs brnyan bzhin du gsal ba byang chub sems kyi ngo bor gyur/ skabs 'dir kun bzang dang jo bo rjes srung 'khor thun mong ma yin pa ma mdzad pa ltar/ bu ston sogs kyis kyang ma mdzad kyang / kun tu bzang mo rin chen rdo rje a bha ya rnams kyis rgyas par gsungs shing mar me mdzad bzang pos kyang /

hūm̐ mdzad yang na gtsug tor ram/ /yang na rtag pa la sogs pas/ /bsrung phyir khro bo 'khor lo la/ /gnas nas bgegs kun gzhom par bya/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de'i phyir a bha yas srung 'khor la/ khro bo bcu ma gtogs dbus na lha med par 'dod pa ni 'thad par ma mthong ngo / /rin chen rdo rjes hūm̐ mdzad la dbang phyug dang dbu ma'i gdan bshad pa'ang kun tu bzang mo nas ma bshad cing 'di la rigs pas kyang mi 'thob bo/ /'dir kun tu bzang mo las srung 'khor thun mong ba ma gsungs shing rin chen rdo rjes gzhan du bshad kyang jo bo dang a bha ya ltar bya'o/ /des na 'di ltar bya ste/ byang chub kyi sems rdzogs byang gi sems la rdzogs byang gi bar du bdud bzhi'i bar chad bsal ba'i phyir du/ de'i 'og tu aṃ las byung ba'i nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hūm̐ las byung ba'i rdo rje nag po rtse lnga pa kha gyes shing rab tu 'jigs pa'i lte bar nyi ma la gnas pa'i hūm̐ nag po/ de las 'od zer phyogs bcur 'phros pas bgegs thams cad rgyang ring du bskrad de 'od zer slar 'dus nas 'og tu 'phros pas 'og thams cad sra zhing brtan pa'i rdo rje'i sa gzhi/ logs rnams su 'phros pas rgya che zhing spangs mtho ba'i rdo rje'i rwa ba dang drwa ba/ steng du 'phros pas rdo rje'i gur dang bla re gzi 'od 'bar ba/ de thams cad dum bu gcig tu gyur pa'i phyi rol tu rdo rje'i me kha dog lngas rab tu 'bar bas bskor ba'i nang gi dbus su oṃ las byung ba'i zla ba'i steng du bh+rūṃ ser po yongs su gyur pa las/ 'khor lo ser po rtsibs bcu pa g.yas bskor du mgyogs par 'khor ba rdo rje 'bar ba'i sprin gyi phreng pa phyogs bcur 'phro ba/ de'i lte ba'i nang gi dbus dang phyogs mtshams kyi rtsibs brgyad kyi rtse mo'i steng gi nam mkha' dang / steng 'og gi rtsibs kyi nang la cung zad ma reg pa rnams su sna tshogs pad+ma dang nyi ma'i gdan re re/

de rnams kyi steng du lho ru dkar po/ nub du dmar po/ steng du ser po/ gzhan rnams su sngon po'i hūm̐ yig re re yongs su gyur ba las/ dbus dang shar nas phyogs dang me nas mtshams g.yas bskor dang / steng 'og rnams su rim pa bzhin du rdo rje dang / tho ba dang / dbyug pa dang / pad+ma dang / rdo rje kha gyes pa dang / lcags kyu dang / dbyug pa sngon po dang / rtse gsum dang / ral gri dang / 'khor lo dang / rdo rje rnams la rang rang gi sa bon gyis mtshan pa rnams su gyur/ de rnams yongs su gyur pa las dbus su hūm̐ mdzad/ shar du gshin rje gshed/ byang du bgegs mthar byed/ shar lhor 'dod rgyal/ lho nub tu dbyug sngon can/ nub byang du stobs po che/ byang shar du mi g.yo ba/ 'og tu gnod mdzes rgyal po de thams cad kyang sku mdog sngon po sngo dmar dkar ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug gi dang po gnyis kyis rang 'od kyi rig ma la 'khyud cing / g.yas gnyis pa rnams kyis rim pa bzhin du/ rdo rje dang tho ba dang khro bo'i rdo rje dang / lcags kyu dang dbyug pa dang rtse gsum dang ral gri dang rdo rje 'dzin pa/ mi g.yo ba'i g.yas gsum pas rdo rje dang gzhan thams cad kyi g.yas gsum pas ral gri 'dzin cing / g.yon gnyis pa rnams kyis nor bu dang gsum pa rnams kyis pad+ma 'dzin pa/ lho ru shes rab mthar byed dkar po dkar sngo dmar ba dang / nub tu pad+ma mthar byed dmar po dmar sngo dkar ba dang / steng du gtsug tor 'khor los bsgyur ba ser po ser sngo dkar ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug gi dang po gnyis kyis rang 'od kyi rig ma la 'khyud pa/ g.yas gnyis pa rnams kyis rim pa bzhin du dbyug pa dkar po dang / pad+ma dmar po dang 'khor lo ser po 'dzin cing gsum pa rnams kyis ral gri 'dzin pa/ g.yon gnyis pa rnams kyis nor bu 'dzin cing pad+ma mthar byed kyi g.yon gsum pas 'khor lo dang gzhan gnyis kyi g.yon gsum pas pad+ma 'dzin pa'o/

/mi g.yo ba dang 'dod rgyal dang gnod mdzes dang hūm̐ mdzad rnams sgeg pa'i nyams can/ mche ba cung zad gtsigs pa/ dbu skra nag po la rin po che'i cod pan dang rin po che'i rgyan gyis brgyan cing / dar sna tshogs kyi sham thabs can dang / khro bo gzhan thams cad sbom zhing thung ba mi sdug pa'i nyams can zhal gdangs pa/ mche ba drag tu gtsigs shing ljags 'gyur ba/ smin ma dang sma ra dang dbu skra dmar ser rab tu 'bar ba/ sbrul gyi rgyan dang stag gi lpags pa'i sham thabs can te/ thams cad kyang zhal re re la spyan gsum gsum dang ldan pa ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus na g.yon brkyang gi bstabs kyis bzhugs pa gshin rje gshed la rnam snang dang / pad+ma mthar byed la 'od dpag med/ gzhan thams cad la mi bskyod pas dbu brgyan pa'o/ /thams cad kyi dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs khar hūm̐/ de las 'od zer 'phros pas rang 'dra'i ye shes sems dpa' spyan drangs/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥganyis su med par gyur/ rang rang gi rigs bdag yab yum gyis byang chub kyi sems kyis dbang skur bar gyur/ oṃ ma hā kro dha rā dza ar+ghaṃ nas/ dharma dhā tu'i bar gyis mchod/ bzlas ba la spro na rtsa rgyud nas gsungs pa'i phreng sngags rnams sam/ 'phags lugs nas 'byung ba'i mtshan sngags rnams bzla/ gal te gzhan gyi byad stems la sogs pa bzlog par 'dod na/ gtsug tor 'khor los bsgyur ba dang hūm̐ mdzad brje ba gtso bo bsgyur ba'i gnad dang / gzhan yang bsrung bya sba ba'i gnad dang / lha'i rnam pa'i gnad dang / 'khor lo 'khor ba'i gnad dang / sngags bzlas pa'i gnad de gnad lnga ldan du bya bar rje btsun dam pa sa skya pa rnams kyi man ngag las 'byung ba bzhin du bya'o/ /gnyis pa la dang po sbyor ba/ dkyil 'khor rgyal mchog thig le'i rnal 'byor/ phra mo'i rnal 'byor dang bzhi'o/ /dang po la rten dang / brten pa'i rnal 'byor gnyis las/ dang po ni/

skabs 'di'i rnal 'byor rnams la kun bzang gnyis nas gsal bar gsungs pa bzhin du gzhan rnams la'ang mi mthun pa cher mi snang bas 'di skad ces bya ste/ srung 'khor gyi nang gi dbus kyi khro bo yongs su gyur pa las/ saṃ las rdo rje saṃ gis mtshan pa/ de yongs su gyur pa las/ kun bzang dkar po dkar sngo dmar ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug gi dang po gnyis rang 'od kyi rig ma la 'khyud cing / lhag ma g.yas gnyis rdo rje dang ral gri/ g.yon gnyis rin po dang pad+ma 'dzin pa zla ba'i 'od can zhabs gnyis rdo rje'i skyil krung gis zla gdan la bzhugs shing / rin po che'i rgyan dang dar sna tshogs kyi na bza' can/ de yongs su gyur pa las nam mkha'i khams bde ba chen po'i rang bzhin chos kyi 'byung gnas gru gsum phyi dkar la nang dmar ba yangs shing rgya che ba'i rtsa ba phra ba thur du zug cing gdengs kha che ba gyen du phyogs pa de bzhin gshegs pa'i tshogs kyi 'od zer rab tu 'phro ba'o/ /de'i nang du paṃ ser po las sna tshogs pad+ma 'dab ma 'bum dang ldan pa'i lte bar hūm̐ nag po las sna tshogs rdo rje yangs shing rgya che ba/ de'i lte bar zla ba'i gdan la/ bh+rūm̐ dkar po las byung zhing rten 'brel bcu gnyis rnam par dag pa'i 'khor lo dkar po rtsibs bcu gnyis pa'i lte bar yang zla ba la gnas pa'i bh+rūm̐ dkar po las 'od zer 'phros pas de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad bde ba chen pos mnyes nas rnam snang gi rnam par spyan drangs ste bh+rūm̐ la thim pa'i 'khor lo zla ba bh+rūm̐ dang bcas pa yongs su gyur pa las rnam snang dkar po dkar sngo dmar ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug gi dang po gnyis rang 'od kyi yum la 'khyud cing / lhag ma g.yas gnyis 'khor lo dang ral gri/ g.yon gnyis rin po che dang pad+ma 'dzin pa/ zhabs gnyis rdo rje'i skyil mo krung gis bzhugs shing zla ba'i 'od zer rab tu 'phro ba/ ral pa'i thor tshugs dang rin po che'i rgyan du mas brgyan cing dar sna tshogs kyi na bzas blubs pa/

de yongs su gyur pa las thar pa chen po'i khang bzangs gzhal med khang chen po rin po che sna lnga las rdzogs par grub pa thub pa'i dbang po'i 'od zer gyis mtha' yas pa'i phyogs kun tu khyab pa/ gru bzhi sgo bzhi pa/ phyi nas rim pa bzhin du dkar ser dmar ljang sngo ba'i rim pa lnga dang ldan pa'i rin po che'i rtsig pas yongs su bskor ba'i steng na/ rin po che'i pha gu gzhi dmar po la rin po che zur gsum dang gru bzhi la sogs pas spras pa/ de'i steng na gnas pa'i gser gyi ske rags bzhi'i phyi ngos su chu srin gyi kha nas 'phyang pa'i mu tig gi do shal dang do shal phyed pa dang me long dang rnga yab dang nyi ma dang zla ba dang me tog gi phreng ba rnams kyis brgyan pa/ de'i phyi'i ngos su bya 'dab las 'phyang ba'i rin po che'i shar bu dkar po rtse mo thur du dud pa/ de'i steng du rin po che'i mda' yab pad+ma 'dab ma phyed pa'i dbyibs can gyis yongs su bskor ba'i bar bar du gser gyi bum pa nas 'thon pa'i rgyal mtshan dang ba dan brgyad brgyad dal bu'i rlung gis legs par bskyod pa'i rnga yab rnams las dpyangs pa'i dril bu g.yer kha las yan lag dgu dang ldan pa'i dam pa chos kyi sgra snyan par sgrogs shing phyi'i steng gi zur bzhi la rin po che'i gdugs dkar po bzhis brgyan pa/ rtsig pa'i 'gram nas 'dod yon gyi snam bu dmar pos bskor ba la bzhugs stabs dang kha dog sna tshogs pa'i lha mo rnams kyis mchod pa byed bzhin pa/ sgo dang sgo khyud kyi phyi'i mtshams dang rtsig pa'i phyi nang gi zur bzhir zla phyed la gnas pa'i rin po che dmar po'i steng du rdo rjes brgyan pa/ sgo bzhi so so'i mdun du stegs bu gru bzhi pa'i steng du bum pa la gnas pa'i ka ba bzhi bzhis stegs pa'i rta babs gser dang shar bu dang rin po che dang rta rmig dang mun snam dang wa ran tra dang mun pa dang shar bu dang rin po che dang /

rmig pa dang mda' yab te snam bu bcu gcig dang ldan pa'i mda' yab kyi rtse mor chos kyi 'khor lo'i g.yas g.yon du ri dwags pho mo dang bcas shing rmig pa dang wa ran tra'i sne mor rgyal mtshan dang ba dan dang gdugs kyis brgyan pa/ rta babs kyi g.yas g.yon du bum pa bzang po las skyes pa'i dpag bsam gyi shing la rgyal srid rin po che sna bdun dang bar bar du grub pa thob pa dang sprin gyi gseb nas 'byung ba'i lha mo me tog gi phreng ba bzung ba rnams kyis kun nas mdzes par byas pa'o/ /gzhal yas khang gi nang dkyil 'khor gyi phyed kyi tshad kyi phyi ngos su 'od zer rnam pa lnga'i phreng bas bskor ba'i nang du rdo rje rtse gsum pas zlum por bskor ba la brten pa'i shar du 'khor lo/ lhor rin po che/ nub tu pad+ma/ byang du ral gris mtshan pa'i ka ba gnyis gnyis kyis bteg pa'i rdo rje'i gdung gis mdzes par phub pa'i rtse mor rdo rje rin po che'i tog gis spras pa/ rin pa gnyis pa'i grwa'i g.yas g.yon gnyis su bdud rtsis gang ba'i rin po che'i bum pa gnyis gnyis ste bum pa brgyad kyis mdzes par byas pa/ lha dang mi las yon tan khyad par du 'phags pa'i mchod pa'i sprin spung tshad med pas phyi nang kun tu brgyan pa'i khang bzangs dam pa phyi ltas nang gsal ba nang ltas phyi gsal ba'i nang gi steng dang 'og gi sa gzhi thams cad shar dkar/ lho ser/ nub dmar/ byang ljang / dbus sngo bar gyur pa'i nang gi ling tshe dgu dang rim pa gnyis pa'i grwa bzhi dang shar sgo'i g.yas g.yon gnyis dang sgo bzhi rnams su sna tshogs pad+ma'i gdan re re/ nang gi shar las gzhan pa'i phyogs gsum dang sgo bzhir pad+ma'i lte ba la nyi ma'i gdan re re dang gzhan rnams su zla ba'i gdan re re ste rten gyi dkyil 'khor ye shes kyi gzhal med khang gi mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa lung dang rtogs pa'i chos thams cad rnam par dag pa ni/

mi mnyam pa dag med pas zur bzhir mnyam/ /dran dang dbang po mchog gis sgo rnams yin/ /bsam gtan bzhi po rnams kyis rta babs te/ /ting 'dzin kha khyer gyis ni legs par bskor/ /kha khyer der legs bsten pa'i mchod pa ni/ /dam pa 'dzin rnams gzungs kyi tshogs yin no/ /rgyan rnams kun gyis rnam par brgyan pa ni/ /gang phyir 'gro ba'i bsam kun rdzogs byed pa'o/ /rlung gis bskyod pa'i ba dan phreng ba dang / /sgra sgrogs dril bus phyogs sgo kun khyab pa/ /gang phyir dam chos gsung rab yan lag dgu/ /gdul bya thams cad la ni bskyod pa 'o/ /me long drwa ba drwa phyed me tog gi/ /phreng ba sna tshogs kyis brgyan mnyam med pa/ /me long ye shes dri med byang chub kyi/ /yan lag me tog dri ni phun sum tshogs/ /ka ba bzang po brgyad kyis nyer mdzes pa/ /rnam thar brgyad po rnam par dag pa yin/ /rdo rje'i thig dang yang dag ldan pa ni/ /rdo rje theg chos 'khor lo rab bskor ba'o/ /bla med mtha' yas 'dod pa'i yon tan lnga/ /gzugs sogs yul rnams rnam par dag pa yin/ /mchod pa lnga yis rnam par brgyan pa ni/ /chos dbyings rnam par dag pa'i rgyu mthun no/ /sna tshogs pad+ma'i lte bar legs gnas pa'i/ /nyi zla mgon bcas lha yi gdan rnams ni/ /skyon gyis ma gos mi shes mun sel zhing / /nyon mongs tsha gdung zhi bar byed pa 'o/ /zhes brjod do/ /'dir gzhal yas khang gi mtshan nyid ni/ gzhan kun na rgyas par mi bzhugs pas slob dpon a bha yas bshad pa ltar bkod la/ dag pa sbyar rgyu ma tshang ba 'ga' zhig bsnan pa ni/ dag pa dang sbyar ba'i kun bzang gi tshig bcad 'di rnams kyi dgongs pa bkod pa ste/ tshig rkang phyi ma gnyis rin chen rdo rjes bshad pa'i don bsdus pa'o/ /gnyis pa brten pa la bsnyen bsgrub chung ngu'i yan lag dang / bar ma'i yan lag go /dang po la bsnyen pa/ nyer bsgrub/ sgrub pa/ sgrub chen bzhi las/

dang po la rgyu dang 'bras bu'i rdo rje 'dzin pa gnyis kyi dang po ni/ skabs 'dir bar do ma zhugs bar gyi rgyu rdo rje 'dzin pa'i gnas skabs thams cad pha ma'i rnal 'byor yin pas rang nyid lha'i nga rgyal mi byed par rang las rgyud gzhan pa'i sangs rgyas yab yum mngon byang lnga las bskyed par kha cig 'dod pa ni mi 'thad de/ mngon byang gi skabs rnams su/ kun tu bzang mo nas/ badz+ra āt+ma ko3 haṃ dang / ya thā sarba ta thā ga ta ta thā a haṃ dang / mar me mdzad bzang pos snga ma dang / su bi shud dha dharma dhā tu swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3 haṃ dang / rin chen rdo rje dang jo bos sngags dang po nyid bshad pa thams cad la a haṃ zhes pa nga'o zhes nga rgyal 'dzin dgos pa'i phyir dang / kun bzang las/ nga rgyal dang ldan mtha' yas sprul ba yis/ /zhes sogs dang / kun tu bzang mo las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du skad cig gis rnal 'byor pa rje btsun rdo rje 'dzin par gyur te zhes dang / mar me mdzad bzang pos/ bdag la de'i nga rgyal bya/ /oṃ badz+ra a haṃ zhes dang jo bo dang rin chen rdo rje dang / shān+ti pa rnams kyis bdag nyid rdo rje 'dzin pa zhes/ mgrin gcig tu gsungs pa'i phyir dang / mngon byang lnga po rnams shes lnga gnas gyur zhing ye shes lngar bshad la/ de las sems can gyi don rgyas par byed tshul 'byung ba rnams kyis rnal 'byor pa la phan gnod med par 'gyur ba sogs kyi skyon mtha' yas so/ /'on kyang bar do rgyud tha dad pa gnyis byed pa'ang mi bde bas/ bar do dngos ni nam mkhar bzhag pa'i yi ge yin la/ des rmi lam du yul gzhan du phyin nas bya ba gzhan byed pa dang rjes su mthun par rgyu rdo rje 'dzin pa mngon byang lnga'i tshul gyis sangs rgyas te 'dod chags chen pos gdul bar bya ba'i sems can rjes su 'dzin pa sogs byas pas/ gzhi la pha ma dang tshul mthun zhing / 'bras bu mngon byang lnga las gzhan don phrin las 'grub pa'i lam du 'gro ba cig skabs 'di'i go don du bzung ngo /

/de'i tshul la'ang dpal 'bras kyis dang po nas zla ba gcig las mi bsgom pa ni kun bzang dang mar me mdzad kyi gzhung la gcig gnyis gang du'ang mi gsal yang / gzhan rnams nas smon 'jug so sor phye ste zla ba gnyis su byas pa dang 'gal zhing / phyis kyi mkhas pa dag gis/ rdor dbyings nas bshad pa'i sngags tshan lnga mngon byang re re la sbyar ba ni gzhung che ba 'di rnams gang na'ang mi bzhugs pas mi bya'o/ /de ltar na spyir rgya gzhung spyi dang khyad par kun tu bzang mo dang bstun nas 'di skad ces bya ste/ dbus kyi zla ba'i gdan la bar snang gi yi ge las 'phros pa'i rang gi sgo gsum gyi yig 'bru gsum gzugs brnyan ltar gsal bas/ bdag nyid 'jam pa'i dbyangs su 'tshang rgya ba'i phyir du phyogs bcu'i sems can gyi don la bzhugs pa'i de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad bskul bas de rnams kyis rang la byin gyis brlabs shing 'od du zhu nas 'og tu/ a ā/ i ī/ u ū/ ṛ ṝ/ l̥ l̥̄/ e ai o au aṃ aḥrnams g.yas bskor dang / slar yang a ā nas aṃ aḥrnams g.yon bskor te mtshan so gnyis kyi rang bzhin dbyangs so gnyis yongs su gyur pa las/ zla ba'i dkyil 'khor dbyangs dkar po so gnyis kyis mtshan pa smon pa sems bskyed dang shes rab kyi rang bzhin dang / steng du ka kha ga gha nga / tsa tsha dza dzha nya/ ṭa ṭha ḍa ḍha ṇa/ ta tha da dha na/ pa pha ba bha ma/ ya ra la wa/ sha ṣa sa ha ṣaḥ ya ra la wa ḍa ḍha rnams g.yas bskor dang / slar yang ka nas/ ḍha rnams g.yon bskor te dpe byad brgyad cu'i rang bzhin gsal byed brgyad bcu yongs su gyur pa las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gsal byed dmar po brgyad cus mtshan pa 'jug pa sems bskyed dang thabs kyi rang bzhin du gyur pa'i zla ba gnyis ni thog bcas kyi nyes pa dang bral zhing shin tu gsal bas kun gzhi'i rnam shes gnas gyur pa me long lta bu'i ye shes las byang chub pa'o/ /zla ba de gnyis dbyer med du 'dres nas gcig tu gyur pa ni thabs shes gnyis su med pas nyon yid gnas gyur pa mnyam pa nyid kyi ye shes las byang chub pa'o/

/zla ba'i steng du hūm̐ dmar po las byung ba de rdo rje rtse lnga pa nor bu pad+ma rā ga ltar dmar pa'i lte bar zla ba la gnas pa'i hūm̐ yig dkar po 'od zer 'bar bas mtshan pa ni brjod bya dang rjod byed las 'das pas yid shes gnas gyur pa so sor rtog pa'i ye shes las byang chub pa'o/ /hūm̐ gi 'od zer gyis 'gro ba thams cad rnam par sbyangs shing rdo rje 'dzin pa'i go 'phang la bkod de/ slar 'dus nas hūm̐ la thim pa ni gzung ba dang 'dzin pas stong pas dbang shes gnas gyur pa bya ba grub pa'i ye shes las byang chub pa'o/ /oṃ badz+ra ā t+ma ko3 haṃ/ slar yang hūm̐ gi 'od zer gyis phyogs bcu'i de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad bde ba chen pos mnyes par byas nas rdo rje sems dpa'i rnam par spyan drangs pa rnams hūm̐ la thim pa'i rkyen gyis zla ba rdo rje hūm̐ dang bcas pa yongs su gyur pa las/ rang nyid thub pa'i dbang po kun gyi rdul phra rab las byung ba 'gro ba rnams kyi de kho na nyid sangs rgyas kun gyi yab tu gyur pa'i rdo rje sems dpa' sku mdog dkar po zhes pa nas/ rin po che'i rgyan dang dar sna tshogs kyi na bza' can du gyur/ zhes pa'i bar gong gi kun bzang gi ji bzhin brjod cing bsam pa ni dri ma thams cad dang bral bas rang bzhin gnas rigs gnas gyur pa chos dbyings ye shes las byang chub pa'o/ /oṃ ya thā sarba ta thā ga ta ta tha a haṃ/ 'dir kun tu bzang mo las sngags 'di gong du bshad cing / zla ba yongs su gyur nas rdo rje bshad pa ni gzhung 'di dar ma grags kyis rang 'gyur du 'dug pa'i 'gyur skyon yin nam brtag par bya la ma yin na ni tshul de yang rung par gsal lo/ /'di rnams dang 'og gi snying rje'i dbang bskur la 'phags pa rin po ches tshul gzhan du bshad pa ni btang snyoms su bzhag par bya'o/ /de nas sems can la dbang bskur ba'i rnal 'byor 'di rnams ni/

rtsa rgyud le'u dang po'i zil non rdo rje'i ting nge 'dzin gyi skabs nas zur tsam gsungs pa 'phags lugs pa rnams kyis lhag mos kyi mdzad par sbyar la/ 'dir de dang khyad par dus kyi 'khor lo'i dkyil 'khor rgyal mchog tu gsungs pa'i rnam gzhag dang mthun par skabs 'dir bcud kyi zhing sbyong byed du gsungs shing / de yang rin chen rdo rje dang rtsa rgyud kyi 'grel pa 'dus pa'i rgyan gnyis las sa bon gyis dbyung ba kho na ma gtogs bskyed pa dang mig sogs sbyong ba bkag la/ jo bo rjes sems can rnams sa bon k+ṣiṃ la sogs pa rnams las sa snying sogs su bskyed cing sa bon de nyid kyis 'byin par bshad/ kun bzang du/ de rjes sa bon gyis ni dbyung bar bya/ /zhes dbyung ba dngos su gsungs shing bskyed pa mi gsal la/ dkyil chog rtsa 'grel yang de dang 'dra/ kun tu bzang mo las/ mngal gyi dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo dang rnam snang gi bar gyi sa la sems can rnams lha nyi shu rtsa gcig tu cho ga gsum bskyed byas nas 'byin pa dang / phyung pa'i sems can lhar gyur ba rnams kyis ched brjod mdzad pa sogs gsungs pa dang / sman zhabs pas sa bon gyis 'byin pa bkag pa la sogs pa mi mthun pa mang du byung yang / lam gyi gnad dang sngags kyi brda' chad kyi grub mtha' chug pa sogs kyi skyon can mi bskyed pas/ gang ltar byas na'ang 'gal ba cher med pas/ 'di ltar bya ste/ de nas 'dod chags chen pos gdul bar bya ba'i sems can gyi 'jig rten gsang ba 'dus pa bstan par bya ba'i snod du mngon par gzigs nas/ yab yum snyoms par zhugs pa'i shin tu dga' ba'i glu dbyangs kyis rgyal ba yab yum thams cad spyan drangs te/ rang gi lus la zhugs pa'i rkyen gyis rang nyid bde ba chen po lhag par rgyas pas yum mnyes par gyur cing rang gi lus las spyan sogs yum bzhi dang gzugs sogs lha mo lnga ste/

rig ma dgu phyir 'phros nas yum la thim pa'i rkyen gyis yum bde ba chen po lhag par rgyas pas yab mnyes par gyur/ slar yang rang gi thugs kha nas 'phros pa'i 'od zer gyis sangs rgyas thams cad rdo rje 'dzin pa lha bcu dgu'i bdag nyid du spyan drangs pa rang gi zhal nas zhugs/ rjes su chags pa'i mes byang chub kyi sems su zhu ba rdo rje'i lam nas yum gyi pad+mar babs pa'i thig le yongs su gyur pa las/ 'jam pa'i rdo rje'i bdag nyid rdo rje sems dpas gtso byas pa'i lha bcu dgu'i dkyil 'khor rten dang brten par bcas pa gsal la yongs su rdzogs pa dus gcig tu grub par gyur pa las 'phros pa'i 'od zer dang / rang gi thugs kha'i 'od zer gyis mtha' yas pa'i sems can thams cad bkug nas slob ma 'jug pa'i tshul du dkyil 'khor gyi sgo bzhi nas bcug ste dkyil 'khor gyi nang du 'khod par gyur/ slar yang rang gi thugs kha'i 'od kyis phyogs bcu'i rigs lnga yum bzhi sems dpa' sems ma bcu gnyis la sogs pa'i rgyal ba 'khor bcas spyan drangs te rang gi zhal nas zhugs pa rjes su chags pa'i mes byang chub kyi sems dang ro gcig tu gyur pa rdo rje'i lam nas 'thon pas sems can de rnams la dbang bskur bas phung khams skye mched thams cad sbyangs nas thig ler zhu ba yongs su gyur pa las k+ṣiṃ dz+rīṃ khaṃ gaṃ kaṃ saṃ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ khaṃ raṃ laṃ maṃ paṃ taṃ bh+rūṃ aṃ dz+rīṃ khaṃ hūm̐ rnams las byung pa'i sa snying dang phyag rdor dang nam snying dang / 'jig rten dbang phyug dang / sgrib sel dang / kun bzang dang / gzugs dang / sgra dang / dri dang / ro dang / reg bya dang / chos dbyings rdo rje ma dang / spyan ma dang / mā ma kī dang / gos dkar mo dang / sgrol ma dang / rnam snang dang / rin 'byung dang / 'od dpag med dang / don grub dang / mi bskyod pa ste/ lha nyi shu rtsa gcig gi sku gsung thugs kyi yon tan mtshan dpe la sogs pa thams cad tshang la yongs su rdzogs par gyur pa rnams k+ṣiṃ dz+rīṃ nas khaṃ hūṃ zhes brjod pas mngal nas mthon te nam mkhar 'khod nas bka' drin rjes su dran pa'i tshul gyis/

de bzhin gshegs pa khyod nyid ni/ /bdag gi pha ma ston pa lags/ /e ma sangs rgyas thams cad kyi/ /byang chub sems kyi 'jug pa ni/ /de bzhin gshegs pa kun gyi gsang / /rnyog med rnam par mi rtog pa'o/ /zhes ched du brjod pa ched du brjod nas rang rang gi zhing du gshegs par gyur to/ /'dir kha cig mngal gyi dkyil 'khor la sems can bcug nas phyis gshegs su gsol ba dang / kha cig sems can rnams phyir gshegs pa'i rjes su dkyil 'khor yang rang bzhin gyi gnas su gshegs par 'dod mod kyi/ dkyil 'khor gshegs pa ni gzhung khungs thub rnams su ma byung zhing 'og tu yab yum gnyis dang lhan cig zhu bar byas na'ang 'gal ba yod par mi sems la/ jo bo'i bzhed pa ltar dmigs med kyi ngang du bzhag na'ang rung ngo / /gnyis pa ni/ de nas rang nyid bsams bzhin du srid pa don du gnyer ba'i dri za'i nga rgyal gyis nam mkhar gnas pa yang / sangs rgyas yab yum gyi 'dod chags chen po'i mdzad pa rmad du byung ba de mthong ba'i rkyen gyis bde ba chen po lhag par rgyas pa yab kyi zhal nas zhugs te rdo rje'i lam nas yum gyi pad+mar babs pa chos 'byung gi phyag rgya'i 'od kyis reg ma thag tu 'dod chags chen po'i rang bzhin kha dog dmar po'i thig ler gyur/ de'i 'od kyis yab yum gnyis kyang byang chub kyi sems su zhu ba dang lhan cig zla ba zhu ba lta bu'i thig le dri ma med pa 'od 'phro bar gyur te/ spros pa thams cad nye bar zhi ba'i 'od gsal rnam par mi rtog pa chos sku'i ngang du zhugs par gyur to/ /de lta bu'i 'od gsal 'ba' zhig gis 'gro ba'i don mi nus par mthong nas sngon yun ring du goms pa'i rang gi byams sogs tshad med pa bzhi po de nyid lha mo bzhir gyur te mtshams bzhir 'khod pa rnams kyis snyan pa'i glu dbyangs kyis bskul ba ni/ 'dir mā ma kī dang por bshad pa ni byams pa tshad med pa'i rang bzhin yin pa la dgongs nas/

rtsa rgyud dang kun tu bzang mo dang / rin chen rdo rje dang / shān+ti ba rnams kyis gsungs so/ /mā ma kīs/ sems can khams na gnas kyi dbang phyug khyod ni rdo rje'i thugs/ /dga' ba yid 'ong don chen 'dod pas bdag la bskyab tu gsol/ /mgon po gal te de ring bdag ni gson par mchis bzhed na/ /sems can yab chen gnyen mchog bdag la dgyes par mdzad du gsol/ /spyan mas rdo rje'i sku khyod bka' yi 'khor lo sems can kun la phan/ /sangs rgyas don du byang chub don dam rjes su phan brtson pa/ /mgon po gal teྎ /'dod chags dam tshig chags pas bdag la dgyes par mdzad du gsol/ /gos dkar mos/ khyod ni rdo rje'i gsung ste kun la phan zhing thugs brtse ba/ /'jig rten dag gi dgos pa'i don mdzad pa la rtag tu brtson/ /mgon po gal teྎ /rab dga'i spyod pa kun tu bzang pos bdag la dgyes par mdzod/ /sgrol mas/ khyod ni rdo rje 'dod pa dam tshig mchog gi phan don che/ /yang dag rdzogs sangs rgyas kyi gdung mchog mnyam pa nyid gzigs pa/ /mgon po gal teྎ /yon tan rin chen mang po'i gter gyur bdag la dgyes par mdzod/ /ces bskul bas/ 'od gsal las gdul bya sna tshogs dang rjes su mthun pa'i gzugs skur bzhengs pa'i ched du sgyu ma lta bu'i ting nge 'dzin mngon du mdzad pa'i thig le de thig le gnyis su gyur pa'i gcig yongs su gyur pa las/ maṃ yig dmar ser dri ma med pa'i 'od zer lnga 'phro pa las skyes pa'i ral gri sngon po gser gyi yu bas brgyan pa 'od kyi drwa bas bskor ba'i yu ba la gnas pa'i zla ba'i steng du maṃ yig gur gum gzhon nu'i mdog can shin tu gsal ba las 'od zer phyogs bcur 'phros pas 'gro ba thams cad 'jam pa'i rdo rje'i go 'phang la bkod pa rnams phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas thams cad dang lhan cig 'jam dbyangs dmar ser zhal gsum phyag drug pa'i rnam par spyan drangs te maṃ yig la thim/

ral gri zla ba maṃ dang bcas pa yongs su gyur pa las rang nyid dpal ldan 'jam pa'i rdo rje sku mdog dang rtsa zhal dmar ser gtso ma'i gser gyi lhun po la thun mtshams kyi sprin gyis g.yogs shing nyi ma 'char ka'i zer gyis spros pa lta bu g.yas zhal in+d+ra nī la ltar sngo zhing / g.yon zhal ston ka'i zla ba ltar dkar ba/ zhal gsum po re re yang shin tu zhi ba'i spyan gnyis gnyis dang rab tu mdzes pa'i smin tshugs kyis mdzes pa/ rin po che'i sor gdub kyi spras pa'i phyag drug gi dang po gnyis kyis rang 'od kyi rig ma la 'khyud cing / lhag ma g.yas gnyis mthon mthing ltar sngo ba'i ral gri dang mda'/ g.yon gnyis rab tu rgyas pa'i ut+pa la dang gzhu 'dzin pa/ zhabs gnyis rdo rje'i skyil mo krung gis bzhugs shing skyes bu chen po'i mtshan so gnyis dang dpe byad brgyad cus brgyan pa/ mchog tu sgeg pa'i gzhon nu dpag tu med pa'i rigs kyi sprul pa phyogs bcur 'phro zhing / mthon mthing ral pa'i zur phud lnga la dri zhim me tog gi phreng pas brgyan pa nyi zla'i 'od zer rab tu 'bar zhing sil sil gyi sgra sgrog pa'i rin po che'i dbu rgyan dang snyan rgyan/ mgul rgyan dang do shal/ dpung rgyan dang gdub bu/ se mo do dang ske rags ste rin po che'i rgyan brgyad kyis brgyan zhing snyan gong ut+pa la'i gdengs ka dang dar dpyangs kyis mdzes par byas pa/ lha'i dar sna tshogs kyi na bza' bsnams shing dngos po 'khor ba dang dngos med zhi ba la mi gnas pa'i sku gsung thugs kyi yon tan thams cad dang ldan par gyur/ oṃ dharmā dhā tu swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3 haṃ/ 'di dag ni rgyu mthun pa'i 'bras bu dang bsnyen pa'i yan lag chung ngu ste nyon yid rnam par dag pa me long lta bu'i ye shes so/ /gnyis pa nyer bsgrub ni/ mig sogs byin gyis brlob pa yin la/ 'dir rin chen rdo rjes/

phung khams skye mched thams cad lha'i gzugs kyis ma sbyangs na sangs rgyas su mi 'gyur bas mtha' dag sbyang dgos la/ dngos su mig sogs drug sbyong par gsungs pa ni mtshon pa yin no zhes zer nas/ lha nyi shu rtsa gcig tshang ma lus la bskyed nas 'god pa byas mod kyi gzhung gzhan thams cad nas ma bshad pas 'di ltar bya ste/ rang gi mig gnyis su mig dbang gi rang bzhin k+ṣiṃ dkar po yongs su gyur pa las 'khor lo dkar po rtsibs brgyad pa'i lte bar zla ba la gnas pa'i k+ṣiṃ dkar po de las 'od zer 'phros pas de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad mnyes par gyur te sa snying gi rnam par spyan drangs nas/ de la thim de rnams yongs su gyur pa las sa snying dkar po dkar sngo dmar ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug gi 'og ma g.yas gnyis 'khor lo dang ral gri/ g.yon gnyis nor bu dang pad+ma 'dzin pa/ rna ba gnyis su rna ba'i dbang po'i ngo bo dz+rīṃ nag po yongs su gyur pa las/ rdo rje nag po rtse lnga pa'i lte bar yang zla ba la gnas pa dz+rīṃ nag po de las 'od zer 'phros pas de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad mnyes par gyur te phyag rdor gyi rnam par spyan drangs nas de la thim/ de rnams yongs su gyur pa las/ phyag rdor nag po nag dkar dmar ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug gi 'og ma g.yas gnyis rdo rje dang ral gri/ g.yon gnyis nor bu dang pad+ma 'dzin pa/ de bzhin du sbyar te/ sna gnyis su khaṃ ser po dang / rin po che ljang khu cha dgu pa las nam snying ser po ser nag dkar ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug gi lhag ma g.yas gnyis nor bu dang ral gri/ g.yon gnyis 'khor lo dang pad+ma 'dzin pa/ lce'i dbus su gaṃ dmar po dang pad+ma dmar po 'dab ma brgyad pa las 'jig rten dbang phyug dmar po dmar nag dkar ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug gi 'og ma g.yas gnyis pad+ma dang ral gri/ g.yon gnyis nor bu dang 'khor lo 'dzin pa/ skra mtshams kyi dpral ba'i nang du kaṃ ljang khu dang ral gri ljang khu 'od 'phro ba las/

sgrib sel ljang khu ljang nag dkar ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug gi 'og ma/ g.yas gnyis ral gri dang 'khor lo/ g.yon gnyis nor bu dang pad+ma 'dzin pa/ lte bar saṃ dkar po dang / rdo rje dkar po rtse lnga pa las kun bzang dkar po dkar nag dmar ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug gi 'og ma g.yas gnyis rdo rje dang ral gri/ g.yon gnyis nor bu dang pad+ma 'dzin pa/ drug ka'ang phyag dang po gnyis kyis rang 'od kyi rig ma la 'khyud pa zhabs rdo rje'i skyil mo krung gis zla ba'i gdan la gzhug shing zla ba'i 'od 'phro ba rin po che'i rgyan sna tshogs pas rgyan zhing dar sna tshogs kyi na bzas kun nas klubs pa'o/ /'di dag ni nye bar bsgrub pa chung ngu dang rnam smin gyi 'bras bu'i yan lag chung ngu ste yid shes gnas gyur pa mnyam pa nyid kyi ye shes so/ /gsum pa sgrub pa ni/ 'dir slob dpon shān+ti pas snying kha la sogs pa'i gnas rnams su sa bon las byung ba'i phyag mtshan gsum gyi dbus su rdo rje gsum gyi lha bzhugs par bshad pa ni/ kun bzang las/ ji bzhin bkang nas dri med rang snying zla'i/ /rdo rje'i lte ba'i dbus su yi ge hūm̐/ /thugs kyi rdo rje de bzhin kha dang ni/ /spyi bor pad+ma 'khor lo la gnas pa'i/ /āḥdang oṃ ni gsung gi rdo rje dang / /sku yi rdo rje nyid du bsam par bya/ /zhes phyag mtshan la gnas pa'i sa bon nyid rdo rje gsum du bsgom pa ltar gsungs pa'i tshig la 'khrul par zad kyi gzhan thams cad kyi rdo rje gsum la cho ga gsum bskyed byas pa ltar bya'o/ /de yang jo bo dang rin chen rdo rje re re nas mchod pa gsol btab sogs bskyed chog dang sbrel la/ kun tu bzang mor dus gcig la bskyed nas/ de rjes mchod pa re re nas phul te gsol btab byas shing gsol btab kyi tshig bcad dang pos de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyi gnas gsum na bzhugs pa'i rdo rje gsum rang gi gnas gsum la 'jug la/

gnyis pa rnams kyis rdo rje can de bzhin gshegs pa de rnams rang la 'jug par bshad/ rin chen rdo rjes/ tshig bcad dang pos rang gis phar sprul ba'i rdo rje gsum dang / gnyis pas gdod ma nas bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas rnams la gsol ba 'debs par bshad do/ /des na 'di skad ces bya ste/ rang gi nu ma gnyis kyi dbus su zla ba la gnas pa'i rang gi sems kyi ngo bo hūm̐ nag po yongs su gyur pa las rdo rje nag po rtse lnga pa'i lte bar yang hūm̐ nag po de las 'od zer 'phros pas 'gro ba rnams thugs rdo rjer byas shing de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad mnyes par gyur te thugs rdo rje'i rnam par spyan drangs nas hūm̐ la thim rdo rje zla ba hūm̐ dang bcas pa yongs su gyur pa las thugs rdo rje phyag rdor lta bu'i thugs khar rdo rje sngon po rtse lnga pa'i lte bar zla ba'i steng du hūm̐ sngon po de bzhin du 'don pa spos nas sbyar te/ rang gi mgrin pa'i nang du zla ba la gnas pa'i rang gi ngag gi ngo bo āḥdamar po dang pad+ma dmar po 'dab ma brgyad pa las/ gsung rdo rje 'jig rten dbang phyug lta bu'i thugs khar pad+ma dmar po 'dab ma brgyad pa'i lte bar zla ba'i steng du āḥdamar po rang gi spyi bor zla ba la gnas pa'i rang gi lus kyi ngo bo oṃ dkar po dang 'khor lo dkar bo rtsibs brgyad pa sku rdo rje sa snying lta bu'i thugs khar 'khor lo dkar po rtsibs brgyad pa'i lte bar zla ba'i steng du oṃ dkar po/ rdo rje gsum po thams cad kyang phyag dang po gnyis kyis rang 'od kyi rig ma zhes pa nas na bzas kun nas klubs pa'o/ /de gsum gyi thugs kha'i sa bon hūm̐ āḥ.oṃ rnams las 'od zer phyogs bcur 'phros pas thugs gsung sku'i rdo rje dpag tu med pa spros shing / gzugs rdo rje ma la sogs pa'i mchod pa'i lha mo mtha' yas pa sprul te/ phyogs bcu'i de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad spyan drangs nas nam mkhar bzhugs pa la phyi dang nang dang gsang ba'i mchod pas mchod par gyur/

oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta ar+ghaṃ pū dza nas/ shrī āḥhūm̐ de bzhin du pā t+yaṃ nas shab+da'i bar sbyar/ dpal ldan thugs kyi rdo rje 'dzin/ /rdo rje mi phyed gsum bsgom pas/ /deng bdag byin gyis brlabs nas su/ /rdo rje thugs kyis mdzad du gsol/ /phyogs bcur bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas rnams/ /rdo rje mi phyed gsum bsgoms pas/ /deng bdag byin gyis brlabs nas su/ /rdo rje thugs kyis mdzad du gsol/ /zhes gsol ba btab pas/ thugs rdo rje dang / de'i rdo rje can rnams snying kha'i thugs rdo rje dang rang la thim/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta tsit+ta badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3 haṃ/ chos kyi gsung lam dpal ldan pa/ /rdo rje mi phyed gsum bsgoms pas/ /man chad 'dra zhes gsol ba btab pas/ gsung rdo rje dang de'i rdo rje can rnams mgrin pa'i gsung rdo rje dang rang la thim/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta wā ka badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3 haṃ/ dpal ldan rdo rje sku 'chang ba/ /rdo rje mi phyed gsum bsgom pas/ ྎ /ces gsol ba btab pas/ sku rdo rje dang de'i rdo rje can rnams dpral ba'i sku rdo rje dang rang la thim/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta kā ya badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3 haṃ/ de rnams ni skyes bu byed pa'i 'bras bu dang bsgrub pa chung ngu'i yan lag ste dbang shes gnas gyur pa so sor rtog pa'i ye shes so/ /bzhi pa sgrub pa chen po ni/ rang gi snying kha'i thugs rdo rje'i gong du zla ba la gnas pa'i maṃ yig dmar ser yongs su gyur pa las ral gri'i yu bar zla ba'i steng du maṃ dmar ser/ de las 'od zer 'phros pas rgyal ba thams cad mnyes par byas te/ 'jam dbyangs kyi rnam par spyan drangs nas maṃ la thim/ ral gri zla ba maṃ dang bcas pa yongs su gyur pa las/ gong du thun mtshams kyi lha gsal 'debs skabs lta bu'i 'jam dbyangs rdo rje skyil mo krung gis bzhugs pa'i thugs khar ral gri'i yu bar zla ba la gnas pa'i ting nge 'dzin sems dpa' maṃ yig dmar ser las 'od zer phyogs bcur 'phros pas dbang gi lha rgyal ba yab yum 'khor dang bcas pa spyan drangs te/

mdun gyi nam mkhar 'khod/ /slar yang maṃ gyi 'od zer gyis sprul pa'i gzugs sogs mchod pa'i lha mo thams cad kyis mchod par gyur/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta ar+ghaṃ nas shap+ta'i bar gyis sngar bzhin mchod/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis bdag la dbang bskur du gsol/ zhes pa'am/ spro na/ byang chub rdo rjes sangs rgyas la/ /mchod chen ji ltar rtsal ba ltar/ /bdag kyang rab tu bsgral ba'i phyir/ /nam mkha'i rdo rjes deng bdag rtsol/ /zhes gsol ba btab pas/ rigs lngas dbang bskur ba'i dgongs pa mdzad/ sems dpa' sems ma rnams kyis rdo rje'i glu dang bcas pa'i bkra shis kyi tshig bcad brjod/ khro bo khro mo rnams kyis bgegs bskrad/ yum rnams kyis rin po che'i bum pa ye shes kyi bdud rtsis gang ba thogs te/ dbang bskur rdo rje chen po ste/ /khams gsum pa yis phyag byas pa/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi gsang gsum pa'i/ /gnas las byung ba sbyin par bya/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shrī hūm̐/ zhes gsung zhing dbang bskur/ lus ye shes kyi bdud rtsis gang / sgo gsum gyi dri ma thams cad dag chu lhag ma spyi gtsug tu gnas pa yongs su gyur pa las rang la mi bskyod pas dbu brgyan par gyur cing / sa snying sogs la'ang rang rang gi rigs kyi bdag pos dbu brgyan par gyur/ dbang lha rnams kyang rang la gnyis su med par thim/ zhes brjod cing bsam/ spro na/ rang dang phyag rdor kun bzang thugs rdo rje ye shes sems dpa' rnams la mi bskyod pa dang / sku rdo rje dang / sa snying la rnam snang / nam snying la rin 'byung / 'jig rten dbang phyug dang gsung rdo rje la snang mtha'/ sgrib sel la don grub kyis dbu brgyan par gyur/ /zhes bya'o/ /'di rnams ni bral ba'i 'bras bu dang / sgrub chen chung ngu'i yan lag ste kun gzhi gnas gyur pa bya ba grub pa'i ye shes so/ /'di rnams kyi gnas gyur dang ye shes sbyor lugs 'di gzhan dang mi mthun pa ni/

'dir spang bya spong sla rims dang / ye shes dang por skye rim sbyar ba yin la/ gzhan du bstan pa rnams spang bya'i khyad chos dang ye shes kyi khyad chos ris 'dra ba la dgongs pa 'dra'o/ /gnyis pa bsnyen sogs bar ma bzhi la bsnyen pa ni/ 'dir bram ze rin chen rdo rjes 'ga' zhig yum la'ang sbyor ba tshogs sog nas gzhal yas khang sgom pa sogs tshad mar byed pa ni/ kun bzang du/ de nas rang lha dang mtshungs rang snying pos/ /sbrul pa'i rig ma nyid ni yang dag lta/ /zhes pa la bltas zhes sogs 'das tshig yod pa sogs kyi rgyu mtshan gyis mi 'thad do zhes lugs de bkag nas/ rang lugs skabs 'dir rig ma sngar yab dang lhan cig bskyed nas grub zin pa gcig gsal 'debs par 'dod pa nyid legs par mthong ste/ de lta ma yin na/ gzhal yas khang yang skyar nas bsgom par 'dod pa'i phyogs la ni khang pa so sor lha yab yum bsgoms pas mthar thabs shes sbyor ba la'ang mi phan zhing snga ma nyid sbyor ba'ang mi rigs so/ /mngon byang lnga bskyed man chad byed pa'i phyogs la'ang bar srid 'jug pa sogs kyang 'di la byed par bshad pas bar do la cha gnyis bzo dgos pa sogs dang / rin chen rdo rjes gsungs pa ltar 'khor gyi bsnyen bsgrub la'ang mtshungs par 'gyur ba sogs kyi skyon 'byung ba'o/ /'on kyang sa bon las skyed pa tsam la ni 'gal ba med par rtogs so/ /des na kun bzangs las ni yum gyi skyed chog la/ bshad ma thag pa'i rkang pa gnyis kyi 'jug tu/ mig sogs dgang zhing de nas yi ge gsum/ /rnam par bkod pas lus ni 'od dang ldan/ /zhes pa las med la/ kun tu bzang mo dang / rin chen rdo rje dang / shān+ti pa dang / jo bo sogs kyis mngon byang lnga bskyed/ bar srid 'jug pa sogs byed par gsungs pa rnams kyang / skyar nas byed pa ma yin gyi snga ma'i zhar la bskyed pa'i sgo nas yum gyi bskyed chog la'ang de rnams tshang dgos zhes par dgongs pa yin te/

de'i phyir na gong du thig le cha gnyis byas pa yin no/ /des na 'di skad ces bya ste/ rang gi mdun na gnas pa'i byang chub kyi sems kyi thig le yongs su gyur pa las yum 'jam pa'i rdo rje ma sku mdog dang rtsa zhal dmar ser gur gum gzhon nu lta bu/ g.yas zhal in+d+ra nī la ltar sngo zhing / g.yon zhal ston ka'i zla ba ltar dkar ba phyag drug gi dang po gnyis yab la 'khyud cing / lhag ma g.yas gnyis ral gri dang mda'/ g.yon gnyis ut+pa la dang gzhu 'dzin pa/ zhabs gnyis pad+ma'i skyil krung gis yab la 'khyud cing gzhon nu lang tsho phun sum tshogs pa dang ldan pa/ sgeg cing chags pa'i nyams kyis shin tu 'dzum pa'i zur gyis blta ba la sogs pa'i rgyu rtsal dang ldan pa/ mthon mthing ral pa'i zur phud lnga la/ zhes pa nas/ lha'i dar sna tshogs kyi na bza' bsnams shing shes rab kyi yan lag thams cad yongs su rdzogs par gyur/ oṃ dharma dhā tu swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3 haṃ/ 'di ni rgyu mthun pa'i 'bras bu dang bsten pa'i yan lag 'bring po'o/ /nyer bsgrub ni/ de'i mig gnyis su mig dbang gi rang bzhin zhes pa nas/ dar sna tshogs kyi na bzas kun nas klubs pa'o/ /zhes pa'i bar snga ma bzhin te rnam smin gyi 'bras bu dang nyer bsgrub kyi yan lag 'bring po'o/ /sgrub pa ni/ de'i nu ma gnyis kyi dbus su zla ba la gnas pa'i hūm̐ nag po las/ zhes pa nas/ na bzas kun nas blubs ba'i bar la rang gi sems dang / ngag dang lus zhes pa rnams bor nas/ de gsum gyi thugs kha'i sa bon hūm̐ āḥzhes pa nas/ shap+ta'i bar brjod nas/ 'di la gsol gdab rnams mi byed par rin chen rdo rjes bshad/ rdo rje gsum gyi lha tshogs thams cad yum gyi gnas gsum du thim par gyur/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta tsit+ta zhes sogs sngags gsum sbrel nas brjod pa ni/ byed 'bras dang sgrub pa 'bring pa'o/ /sgrub chen ni/ de'i thugs kha'i thugs rdo rje'i gong du zhes pa nas/

'jam pa'i rdo rje ma'i rnam par spyan drangs/ zhes sbyar nas/ mi bskyod pas dbu brgyan par gyur/ zhes pa snga ma bzhin bsam pa ni/ bral 'bras dang sgrub chen 'bring po'o/ /yum gyi spyi gtsug nas snying kha'i bar du zla ba la gnas pa'i rnam snang gi rdul phra rab kyi rang bzhin can gyi oṃ dkar po/ snying kha nas lte ba'i bar du mi bskyod pa'i rdul phra rab kyi rang bzhin can gyi hūm̐ nag po/ lte ba nas gsang ba'i bar du rin 'byung gi rdul phra rab gyi rang bzhin can gyi swā ser po/ gsang ba nas brla'i rtsa ba'i bar du 'od dpag med kyi rdul phra rab kyi rang bzhin gyi āḥdamar po/ brla'i rtsa ba nas byin pa'i bar du don grub kyi rdul phra rab kyi rang bzhin can gyi hā ljang khu rnams nyi gdan la gnas pas mtshan par gyur/ rang gi gsang gnas mi dmigs pa'i ngang las hūm̐ las byung pa'i rdo rje dmar po rtse lnga pa oṃ dkar po las byung pa'i nor bu dang ldan pa/ yum gyi gsang gnas mi dmigs pa'i ngang las hūm̐ las byung ba'i pad+ma dmar po 'dab ma brgyad pa ā las byung pa'i ze'u 'bru dang ldan pa/ gnyis ka'ang bu ga phaṭa yig gis bkag par gyur/ yab yum snyoms par zhugs pas de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi dga' ba dang bde ba khyad par can nyams su myong ba'i bde ba chen pos sangs rgyas thams cad mchod par gyur/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a nu rā ga na badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3 haṃ/ zhes brjod cing bsams te/ de yan chad ni dang po sbyor ba'i ting nge 'dzin te rang don phun sum tshogs pa 'dod chags chen po'i lam gyis sgrub par byed pa'o/ /gnyis pa dkyil 'khor rgyal mchog ni/ mngal du dkyil 'khor bskyed pa spros shing bsdus nas dkyil 'khor la bkod de yan lag bzhi rdzogs mchod bstod bdud rtsi myang ba'i bar du byed pa yin la/ 'dir bu ston rin po ches mngal du yang ye shes dgug gzhug dbang bskur/

bdud rtsi myang ba'i bar du byed gsung ba ni rgya gzhung khungs thub gang nas kyang ma byung la/ mngal du rdzogs par bskyed nas rim gyi spro ba yang 'di yi lugs ma yin par go ste/ gzhung kun tu bskyed pa dang spro ba lha re re la sbyar nas gsungs pa'i phyir dang / 'di'i rgyal mchog gnyis dang rnal 'byor gnyis la sogs pa ni dus 'khor nas 'byung ba'i ba dha chang yin la/ der yang rim gyis bskyed nas rim gyis spro ba rgyu mtshan dang bcas nas gsungs pa'i phyir ro/ /de bzhin du/ lha pho rnams kyi yum dang lha mo rnams kyi yab la rang rang gi ming dang ngos 'dzin zur du mdzad pa yang gzhung rnams su mi 'byung zhing lha grangs mang ba la sogs pa'i skyon du 'gyur bas/ rgya gzhung kun tu rang 'od kyi yab yum du gsungs shing / lugs 'di'i lha sku li ma mang po mthong ba la yang dngos su 'khyud yum med pa zhes gcig tu snang bas rang 'od kyi yab dang yum du rigs so/ /rdo rje gsum byin gyis rlob pa'i skabs su spyi bo la sogs pa'i gnas su 'byung bzhi'i gdan mdzad pa'ang gzhung che ba rnams su mi 'byung zhing / kun tu bzang mor ngal gso ba'i skabs dang / rin chen rdo rjes bzlas pa'i skabs su zur tsam gsungs kyang rdo rje gsum dang ma 'brel lo/ /lha rnams kyi mdzad pa la/ kun bzang rang dang jo bos mdzad pa ma sbyar zhing / bod dag gis sbyar ba rnams kun tu bzang mo/ shān+ti ba/ rin chen rdo rje sogs kyis mgrin gcig tu gsungs pa rnams dang ma mthun no/ /sems ma drug gi 'byin sngags jo bos 'bru gsum dang mtshan sngags spel ba yang kun bzang gnyis dang bzhi brgya lnga bcu pa rtsa 'grel/ rin chen rdo rje sogs kyis yig 'bru gsum po nyid 'byin sngags su gsungs pa dang 'gal zhing / chos dbyings rdo rje ma'i rigs bdag mi bskyod par mdzad pa'ang gzhan rnams su rdor sems la bshad pa dang ma mthun no/

/des na 'di skad ces bya ste/ rang gi thugs kha'i ting nge 'dzin sems dpa' maṃ yig las 'od zer phyogs bcur 'phros pas/ phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba yab yum 'khor dang bcas pa thams cad lha bcu dgu'i dkyil 'khor gyi rnam pas spyan drangs pa rnams rang gi zhal nas zhugs te rjes chags kyis mes byang chub kyi sems su zhu ba rdo rje'i lam nas yum gyi pad+mar babs pa'i thig le dri ma med pa'i maṃ yig dmar ser gyis mtshan zhing byin gyis brlabs par gyur/ sangs rgyas thams cad kyi rdul phra rab tu gyur pa'i thig le yongs su gyur ba las rten dang brten pa'i dkyil 'khor du gyur pa'i gzhal yas khang gru bzhi sgo bzhi pa mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa gdan dang bcas par grub pa'i dbus kyi gdan la rgyal ba mi bskyod rdo rje sku mdog sngon po sngo dkar dmar ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug gi dang po gnyis rang 'od kyi rig ma la 'khyud cing / lhag ma g.yas gnyis khro bo'i rdo rje sngon po rtse lnga pa dang ral gri/ g.yon gnyis rin po che dang pad+ma 'dzin pa/ rang gi thugs khar drangs/ badz+ra dhṛka thugs kha nas phyir phyung / phyogs bcu'i zhing du sprul pa dpag tu med pa 'phros/ chos kyi 'khor lo skor ba la sogs pa sangs rgyas kyi mdzad pa thams cad mdzad/ khyad par du sems can rnams kyi zhe sdang sbyangs shing rnam shes kyi phung po gnas gyur te thugs rdo rje dang chos dbyings ye shes la bkod nas slar 'dus te rang nyid la thim par gyur/ shar du rnam snang dkar po dkar nag dmar ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug gi dang po gnyis rang 'od kyi yum la 'khyud cing / lhag ma g.yas gnyis 'khor lo dkar po rtsibs brgyad pa dang ral gri/ g.yon gnyis rin po che dang pad+ma 'dzin pa/ rang gi thugs khar drangs/ dzi na dzika thugs kha nas phyir phyung phyogs bcu'i zhing du sprul pa dpag tu med pa 'phros/ chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba la sogs pa sangs rgyas kyi mdzad pa thams cad mdzad/

khyad par du sems can rnams kyi gti mug sbyangs shing gzugs kyi phung po gnas gyur te/ sku rdo rje dang me long lta bu'i ye shes la bkod nas/ slar 'dus te phyi'i gzhal yas khang gi ling tshe dgu'i shar du zla gdan la 'khod/ de bzhin du sbyar te/ lhor rin 'byung nam snying lta bu rin po che ljang gu cha dgu pa 'dzin pa/ rat+na dhṛka khyad par du sems can rnams kyi nga rgyal sbyangs nas tshor ba'i phung po gnas gyur yon tan rdo rje dang mnyam pa nyid kyi ye shes la bkod/ lhor nyi gdan la 'khod/ nub tu 'od dpag med 'jig rten dbang phyug lta bu pad+ma dmar po 'dab ma brgyad pa 'dzin pa/ ā ro l̥ka khyad par du 'dod chags sbyangs nas 'du shes kyi phung po gnas gyur te/ gsung rdo rje dang so sor rtog pa'i ye shes la bkod/ nub tu nyi gdan la 'khod/ byang du don grub sgrib sel lta bu ral gri sngon po 'od 'phro ba 'dzin pa/ pra dz+nyā dhṛka khyad par du phrag dog sbyangs nas 'du byed kyi phung po gnas gyur te/ phrin las rdo rje dang bya ba grub pa'i ye shes la bkod/ byang du nyi gdan la 'khod/ de bzhin du spyi mdzad bzhag nas gzhan thams cad sbyor lugs 'dra bar byas te/ rang 'od kyi yab la zhes sbyar nas/ shar lhor spyan ma dkar mo rnam snang lta bu/ moha ra ti/ sems can rnams kyi sa'i khams kyi dri ma sbyangs te rnam par thar pa'i sgo stong pa nyid dang snying rje tshad med mngon du byas/ thabs kyi phar phyin dang sa bdun pa ring du song ba la bkod/ shar lhor zla gdan la'o/ /lho nub tu mā ma kī sngon mo phyag rdor lta bu la/ rdo rje'i gnas su ut+pal dmar po 'dzin pa/ dwe ṣa ra ti/ chu'i khams mtshan ma med pa dang / byams pa tshad med pa dang / smon lam gyi phar phyin/ sa brgyad pa mi g.yo ba/ lho nub tu zla gdan la/ nub byang du gos dkar mo 'od dpag med lta bu la/ rā ga ra ti/ me'i khams/

smon pa med pa/ dga' ba tshad med pa/ stobs kyi phar phyin/ sa dgu pa legs pa'i blo gros/ nub byang du zla gdan/ byang shar du sgrol ma ser mo rin 'byung lta bu la/ rin po che'i gnas su ut+pal ser po/ badz+ra ra ti/ rlung gi khams/ mngon par 'du mi byed pa/ btang snyoms tshad med/ ye shes kyi phar phyin/ sa bcu pa chos kyi sprin/ byang shar du zla gdan la 'khod/ de bzhin du/ rim pa gnyis pa'i shar lhor gzugs rdo rje ma rnam snang lta bu la/ 'khor lo'i gnas su me long dmar po oṃ āḥhūm̐/ rang gi thugs kha nas phyir phyung phyogs bcu'i zhing du sprul pa dpag tu med pa 'phros/ sems can rnams kyi gzugs kyi skye mched dang ser sna sbyangs te sbyin pa'i phar phyin dang sa dang po rab tu dga' ba la bkod nas slar 'dus te rim pa gnyis pa'i shar lhor zla gdan la 'khod/ de bzhin du sbyar te/ lho nub tu sgra rdo rje ma/ mi bskyod pa lta bu la/ rdo rje'i gnas su pi wang sngon po/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ sgra'i skye mched dang 'chal tshul/ tshul khrims kyi phar phyin dang / sa gnyis pa dri ma med pa/ lho nub tu zla gdan/ nub byang du dri rdo rje ma rin 'byung lta bu la rin po che'i gnas su dri'i dung chos ser po/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ dri'i skye mched dang khong khro/ bzod pa'i phar phyin dang sa gsum pa 'od byed pa/ nub byang du zla gdan/ byang shar du ro rdo rje ma dmar mo 'od dpag med lta bu la/ pad+ma'i gnas su ro'i snod dmar po/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ ro'i skye mched dang le lo/ brtson 'grus kyi phar phyin dang sa bzhi pa 'od 'phro ba/ byang shar du zla gdan la/ shar sgo'i g.yas su reg bya rdo rje ma ljang gu don grub lta bu la/ ral gri'i gnas su gos kha dog sna tshogs pa/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ reg bya'i skye mched dang rnam g.yeng / bsam gtan gyi phar phyin dang sa lnga pa sbyang dka' ba/ shar sgo'i g.yas su zla gdan la/

shar sgo'i g.yon du chos dbyings rdo rje ma dkar mo rdo rje sems dpa' lta bu la/ rdo rje'i gnas su chos kyi 'byung gnas dkar po/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ chos kyi skye mched dang sher 'chal/ shes rab kyi phar phyin dang sa drug pa mngon du gyur pa/ shar sgo'i g.yon du zla gdan la 'khod/ de thams cad kyang zhabs gnyis rdo rje'i skyil mo krung gis bzhugs shing / dbu skra ral pa'i cod paṇa shin tu mdzes pa/ zhal re re la shin tu zhi ba'i spyan gnyis gnyis dang ldan zhing brgyad gnyis lon pa'i nyams dang ldan pa/ sgeg cing 'dzum pa'i rnam 'gyur gyis bde ba chen po'i longs spyod la lhag par rol ba/ nyi zla'i 'od zer rab tu 'bar zhing sil sil gyi zhes pa nas/ lha'i dar sna tshogs kyi na bza' bsnams shing rnam snang dang lha mo thams cad zla ba'i 'od 'phro ba/ gshegs pa gzhan gsum nyi ma'i 'od 'phro ba'o/ /de bzhin du ngag 'don sngar bzhin sbyar te/ shar sgor gshin rje gshed nag po mi bskyod pa lta bu la/ rdo rje'i gnas su rdo rje tho ba/ ya mān+ta kṛ ta sems can rnams kyi ma dad pa dang / phung po'i bdud dang shes bya'i sgrib pa dang 'jig tshogs la lta ba thams cad sbyangs te dad pa'i dbang po dang chos kyi bdag med kyi lta ba la bkod nas slar 'dus te shar sgor nyi gdan la 'khod/ lho sgor shes rab mthar byed dkar po rnam snang lta bu la/ 'khor lo'i gnas su rdo rje dbyug pa 'dzin pa/ pra dz+nyān+ta kṛta/ le lo dang nyon mongs pa'i bdud dang nyon mongs pa'i sgrib pa dang bdag tu lta ba thams cad sbyangs te/ brtson 'grus kyi dbang po dang gang zag gi bdag med pa'i lta ba la bkod/ lho sgor nyi gdan/ nub sgor pad+ma mthar byed 'od dpag med lta bu la/ pad+ma'i gnas su pad+ma nyid 'dzin pa/ pad+mān+ta kṛta/ brjed ngas dang 'chi bdag gi bdud dang / skyo ba'i sgrib pa dang mthar 'dzin pa'i lta ba thams cad sbyangs te dran pa'i dbang po dang dbu ma'i lta ba la bkod/

nub sgor nyi gdan la/ byang sgor bgegs mthar byed nag po mi bskyod pa lta bu la rdo rje'i gnas su rdo rje nag po kha gyes pa 'dzin pa bigh+nān+ta kṛta/ rnam g.yeng dang / lha'i bu'i bdud dang / las kyi sgrib pa dang log par lta ba thams cad sbyangs te ting nge 'dzin gyi dbang po dang yang dag pa'i lta ba la bkod nas slar 'dus te byang sgor nyi gdan la 'khod/ khro bo bzhi po thams cad kyang dbu skra dmar ser gyen du rjes shing smin ma dang / sma ra dmar ser rab tu 'bar ba/ zhal re re'ang dmar la zlum pa'i spyan gsum gsum dang ldan zhing mche ba rnon po bzhi bzhi gtsigs pa/ ha ha'i gad sgyangs drag po sgrogs shing bzhin shin tu 'gyur ba'i khro gnyer can/ gsus khyim che zhing gsus pa 'phyang ba/ rin po che'i rgyan sna tshogs pas brgyan cing stag gi lpags pa'i sham thabs can/ sbrul mtha' yas sngon pos dbu skra bcings shing / 'jog po dmar pos rna rgyan byas pa/ rigs ldan khra bos dpung pa la brgyan cing pad+ma dkar pos 'gul rgyan byas pa/ dung skyong ser pos lag gdub byas shing / stobs rgyu ljang khus mchod phyir thogs byas pa/ nor rgyas kyi bu bdud rtsi'i kha dog lta bus ske rags byas shing pad+ma chen po dkar pos rkang gdub byas pa/ sku las skyes pa'i ye shes kyi me rab tu 'bar ba'i dbus na gdug pa can thams cad tshar gcod pa'i 'phrin las la brtson pas g.yon brkyang gi stabs kyis bzhugs pa'o/ /gzhal yas khang rang gi thugs khar drangs/ oṃ āḥhūṃ thugs kha nas phyir byung / phyogs bcur 'phros/ snod kyi 'jig rten gyi nyes skyon sbyangs nas dag pa'i zhing du byas/ slar 'dus nas gzhal yas khang la thim/ 'di gzhan rnams nas ma mdzad na'ang / 'di skyed phyin chad 'byin pa'ang rigs pas 'thob bo/ /slar yang rang gi thugs kha'i maṃ yig las 'od zer 'phros pas/ ji ltar bsgoms pa dang 'dra ba'i ye shes pa lha bcu dgu'i dkyil 'khor rten dang brten par bcas pa spyan drangs te shar sgo'i thad kyi nam mkhar 'khod/

oṃ ya mān+ta kṛta hūm̐/ oṃ pra dz+nyān+ta kṛta hūm̐/ oṃ pad+mān+ta kṛta hūm̐/ oṃ bigh+nān+ta kṛta hūm̐/ ye shes pa'i phyi 'brang gi bgegs rnams bskrad/ slar yang thugs kha'i maṃ las sprul pa'i mchod pa'i lha mo rnams kyis bdud rtsi lnga dang me tog dkar pos brgyan pa'i mchod pa du mas mchod par gyur/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta ar+ghaṃ nas/ shap+da pra tīts+tsha swā hā/ oṃ ya mān+ta kṛta dzaḥgashin rje mthar byed kyi dza dmar po'i 'od zer gyis dkyil 'khor gyi nang du spyan drangs/ oṃ pra dz+nyān+ta kṛta hūṃ/ shes rab mthar byed kyi hūm̐ nag po'i 'od zer gyis rten dang brten pa'i dkyil 'khor la bcug oṃ pad+mān+ta kṛta baṃ/ pad ma mthar byed kyi baṃ ser po'i 'od zer gyis dbyer med du bcings/ oṃ bigh+nān+ta kṛta hoḥ bgegs mthar byed kyi hoḥdakar po'i 'od zer gyis ye shes kyi ngo bor gyur te bde stong gis mnyes par gyur/ de rnams ni rgyu mthun gyi 'bras bu dang snyan pa'i yan lag chen po'o/ /de nas 'khor gyi lha thams cad kyi mig gnyis su zla ba la/ zhes pa nas/ na bzas kun nas blubs pa'o/ /zhes pa'i bar sngar bzhin bya ste/ nyer bsgrub sogs chen po'o/ /de nas/ lha thams cad kyi nu ma gnyis kyi zhes pa nas sngags tshan gsum brjod pa'i bar yum gyi ji lta ba bzhin du bya ste sgrub pa sogs chen po'o/ /de nas 'khor rnams la sems dpa' gsum rtsegs ni ma gsungs so/ /de'i phyir/ rang gi ye shes sems dpa'i thugs kha'i maṃ yig dmar ser las 'od zer phyogs bcur 'phros pas/ dbang gi lha/ zhes pa nas/ chu lhag ma spyi gtsug tu gnas pa yongs su gyur pa las/ rnam snang sogs de bzhin gshegs pa bzhi dang / mā ma kī/ sgra rdo rje ma/ shes rab mthar byed/ bgegs mthar byed rnams la mi bskyod pa/ spyan ma gzugs rdo rje ma/ gshin rje gshed rnams la rnam snang / dri rdo rje ma la rin 'byung /

gos dkar mo ro rdo rje ma/ pad+ma mthar byed rnams la 'od dpag med/ sgrol ma dang reg bya rdo rje ma la don grub/ chos dbyings rdo rje ma la rdo rje sems dpas dbu brgyan cing / skye mched sku gsung thugs kyi lha rnams la'ang rang rang gi rigs kyi bdag po rnams kyis dbu brgyan par gyur/ zhes brjod do/ /spro na de rnams la'ang sngar ltar rgyas par brjod do/ /de ni sgrub chen sogs chen po'o/ /de nas mchod bstod bya ba ni/ rang gi thugs kha'i maṃ las 'od zer phyogs bcur 'phros pas/ 'jig rten gyi khams kyi 'dod pa'i yon tan dang mchod pa'i yo byad thams cad bkug ste/ rang gi lus la zhugs pa byang chub kyi sems su gyur te/ rdo rje'i lam nas yum gyi pad+mar babs pa'i thig le bcur gyur pa rnams yongs su gyur pa las/ laṃ maṃ paṃ taṃ dza hūm̐ baṃ hoḥkhaṃ raṃ rnams su gyur/ de rnams las 'od zer 'phros pas lha mo bcu dpag tu med pa spyan drangs te/ de rnams la thim pa yongs su gyur pa las spyan ma nas chos dbyings rdo rje ma'i bar gyi lha mo bcu po gzugs dang lang tsho la sogs pa'i yon tan thams cad kyis brgyan pa/ mchod rdzas dpag tu med pa thogs te yul snang sgyu ma ltar shes pa'i sgo nas/ rgyal ba thams cad mnyes par byed pa rnams phyir 'phros te/ mchod pa rnams kyis mchod par gyur/ tshig bcad dang bcas pa'am/ med kyang rung ste/ oṃ bha ga wān mañju badz+ra de ba tsakra maṇ+ḍa la sa pa ri wā ra ar+ghaṃ pū dza me gha sogs nas/ dharma dhā tu'i bar sngar bzhin du brjod de/ kun bzang du tha dad kun tu rtog las nges grol bya/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar mchod bya mchod byed sogs su 'dzin pa'i 'khor gsum gyi rtog pa thams cad spangs nas rgyal ba thams cad kyi nga rgyal bzung ste/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta pū dza badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3 haṃ/ mchod pa'i lha mo dang bcas pa'i dkyil 'khor pa thams cad kyis bstod bya bstod byed sgra brnyan ltar shes pa'i sgo nas bstod par gyur/

zhes brjod la dril stabs dang bcas te/ mi bskyod rdo rje ye shes che/ /rdo rje dbyings ni mkhas pa che/ /rdo rje gsum mchog dkyil 'khor gsum/ /gsang ba'i dbyings la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rnam par snang mdzad dag pa che/ /rdo rje zhi ba dga' ba che/ /rang bzhin 'od gsal mchog gi mchog /ston pa rdo rje phyag 'tshal lo/ /rin chen rgyal po rab tu zab/ /rdo rje mkha' 'dra dri ma med/ /rang bzhin dag pa gos pa med/ /rdo rje sku la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rdo rje dpag med rgyal po che/ /mi rtog nam mkha' rdo rje 'dzin/ /'dod chags pha rol phyin pa brnyes/ /rdo rje gsung la phyag 'tshal lo/ /don yon rdo rje rdzogs sangs rgyas/ /bsam pa thams cad rdzogs mdzad pa/ /dag pa ngo bo nyid las byung / /rdo rje sems dpa' phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes sogs dang / dpal ldan mi shes kun spangs sogs kyis bstod/ nang mchod byin gyis brlabs pa yod na de'am/ med na skabs 'dir byin gyis brlabs te/ g.yon pa'i mtheb srin gyis g.yon nas g.yas su lan gsum dkrugs te/ dbus nas blangs la/ dang por rtsa ba'i bla ma dang / de rjes brgyud pa'i bla ma rnams kyi mtshan la 'bru gsum btags te smin 'tshams yan chod kyi thad du gtor/ de rjes badz+ra dhṛka oṃ āḥhūm̐/ mañju badz+ra oṃ āḥhūm̐ de bzhin du 'byin sngags su bshad pa'i mtshan sngags rnams dang / sems ma drug la/ rū pa/ shap+da/ gan+dha/ ra sa/ spar+sha/ dharma dhā tu rnams la badz+ra btags pa'i 'jug tu 'bru gsum btags la snying kha'i thad du gtor/ de bzhin du yi dam gzhan la 'bul na'ang de bzhin du bya ste lag pa kha gyen du phyogs pas dbul/ phyogs skyong dang zhing skyong dang gzhi bdag dang rigs drug sogs la lag pa kha 'og tu phyogs pas lte ba man chad kyi thad sor dbul bar bya zhing / rang gis kyang lce rtse smin mtshams spyi bo rnams su reg cing / lce thog tu bzhag la myang te/

nga rgyal 'dzin na/ gong gi pū dza'i gnas su a mṛ ta gzhug gong du bstod pa la nga rgyal 'dzin na'ang stu ti gzhug go /de yan chad ni dkyil 'khor rgyas par bsgoms nas gzhan don gtso bor byed pa dkyil 'khor rgyal mchog gi ting nge 'dzin zhes bya'o/ /gsum pa thig le'i rnal 'byor ni/ 'di dang phra mo'i rnal 'byor gnyis la rin chen rdo rje dang jo bos las rgyal mchog gi ming btags la gzhung gzhan nas de 'dra'i tha snyad mi 'byung ngo / /mdor na ting nge 'dzin gnyis kyis dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo la gsal snang yongs su rdzogs pa bskyed cing / de yang gzung 'dzin dang 'khor 'das sogs gnyis su 'dzin pa'i rnam rtog dang bral ba'i lha sku sgyu ma lta bu la reg mthong gi mtshan ma rnyed rnyed kyi bar du bsgom mo/ /gsal ba tsam gyis mi chog gis gnas pa brtan po gtso bor sgrub cing zhar la bying rgod sel ba ni rnal 'byor gnyis kyis byed pas de yang thog mar bying ba sel byed ni rnal 'byor dang po 'di yin la/ de'i tshul ni/ rang gi ye shes sems dpa'i thugs kha'i ral gri'i yu bar zla ba la gnas pa'i maṃ yig dmar ser de las 'od zer 'phros pas sems can thams cad 'jam pa'i rdo rje'i go 'phangs la bkod pa rnams dang lhan cig de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad spyan drangs te de la thim pa'i rkyen gyis maṃ yig 'od du zhu nas rdo rje gsum gyi rang bzhin du gyur pa'i thig le phra mo 'od zer sna tshogs 'phro ba dwangs shing gsal ba yungs dkar gyi 'bru tsam shin tu 'tsher ba la sems bzung zhing / sems 'phro bar rtsom pa ni thig le de las 'od zer 'phros pas ral gri dang / de las ye shes sems dpa'/ de las rang nyid/ de las dkyil 'khor/ de las snod bcud kyi bar rim gyis kun tu snang bar byas nas slar yang de bzhin du rim gyis bsdus te thig le la thim pa'i thig le las ye shes kyi bdud rtsi 'bab par yun ring du bsam par bya'o/

/de nas thig le la sems brtan pa na/ thig le'i nang du lha bcu dgu'i dkyil 'khor skad cig gis gsal btab la dkyil 'khor thig le dang bcas pa las 'phros pa'i 'od zer rang gi ba spu'i sgo thams cad nas 'phros te phyi nang thams cad snang bas khyab par bsgoms pas bying ba mtha' dag sel bar nus so/ /phra mo'i rnal 'byor ni/ rang gi thugs kha'i sa bon gyi 'od zer gyis nam mkha'i khams gang ba'i rigs lnga la sogs pa'i de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad spyan drangs te rang gi zhal nas zhugs pa byang chub kyi sems su zhu ste rdo rje lam nas yum gyi pad+mar babs pa yongs su gyur pa las zla ba la gnas pa'i ral gri nas 'bru tsam gyi yu ba'i dbus su tsa na ka'i 'bru tshad tsam gyi thig le ye shes lnga'i rang bzhin 'od zer shin tu gsal ba'i nang du lha bcu dgu'i dkyil 'khor rten dang brten par bcas pa skad cig gis gsal btab ste de la yun ring du sems bzung bas du ba la sogs pa'i rtags rnams 'char bar 'gyur la/ mtshan ma de 'dra ma mthong gi bar du mi spro zhing / mthong nas dkyil 'khor du ma yang dang yang du spros te 'gro ba'i don byas nas slar yang bsdu ba'i spro bsdu la bslab par bya'o/ /rnal 'byor 'di gnyis kyi skabs su lha bskyed pa rnams la/ jo bo rjes bsnyen sogs chen po nyid yin par bshad cing / kun bzang gnyis nas mi gsal yang shān+ti ba rin chen rdo rje sman zhabs pa rnams rags pa'i dkyil 'khor dang 'dra bar chung 'bring chen po gsum ka tshang bar bzhed do/ /bsgom pas skyo na/ bzlas pa bya ba ni/ rang gi sku rdo rje dang gsung rdo rje dang ye shes sems dpa' dang thugs rdo rje rnams rim pa bzhin du rlung dang chu dang sa dang me'i dkyil 'khor la gnas par gyur pa'i ye shes sems dpa'i thugs kha'i maṃ yig dmar ser gyi mtha' mar bzlas bya'i sngags kyis bskor bar gyur cing /
