rdo rje bzhi'i thugs kha'i oṃ āḥmaṃ hūm̐ rnams las rlung 'byung ba dang lhan cig sku gsung thugs kyi rdo rje gsum rim pa bzhin du'am/ yang na gcig car du 'phros nas nam mkha' gang ba rnams la gzugs sogs lha mo rnams kyis 'khyud pa la sogs pa'i mchod pas mnyes par byas shing 'gro ba'i don rdzogs pa na maṃ yig gi 'od zer gyis bsdus te yig 'bru rnams la rlung 'jug pa dang lhan cig thim pa'i spro bsdu'i mdzad pa can du gyur/ oṃ āḥmaṃ hūm̐/ zhes pa nyid gtso bor bzlas shing / mthar oṃ āḥbadz+ra dhṛka hūm̐ hūm̐/ oṃ āḥmañju badz+ra maṃ hūm̐/ oṃ āḥdzi na dzika bh+rūṃ hūm̐/ oṃ āḥrat+na dhṛka aṃ hūm̐/ oṃ āḥ.ā ro li ka dz+rīṃ hūm̐/ oṃ āḥpra dz+nyā dhṛka khaṃ hūm̐/ de bzhin du 'bru gsum gyi dbus su/ mo ha ra trī laṃ/ dā+e ṣa ra tī maṃ/ rā ga ra tī paṃ/ badz+ra ra tī taṃ/ rū pa badz+ra dzaḥ shap+da badz+rā hūm̐/ gan+dha badz+ra baṃ/ ra sa badz+ra ho/ spar+sha badz+rā khaṃ/ dharma dhā tu badz+rā raṃ/ ya mān+ta kṛta hūm̐/ pra dz+nyān+ta kṛta hūm̐/ pad+mān+ta kṛta hūm̐/ bi gh+nān+dha kṛta hūm̐/ rnams bcug la bzla'o/ /de lta bu'i bsgom pa dang bzlas pa rtse gcig tu byas pas skyo zhing dub na/ lha mo bzhi'i glus bskul bar bsams nas dkyil 'khor la mchod bstod bya'o/ /lus stobs nyams par 'gyur na/ rang gi spyi bor mtho gang 'phags pa'i thad kyi nam mkhar zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi 'og phyogs kyi dbus su oṃ yig dkar po mgo thur du bstan pa las ye shes lnga'i rang bzhin gyi bdud rtsi'i rgyun dkar po babs pa rang gi tshangs bug nas zhugs te/ rtsa sbubs thams cad gang zhing rlan dang drod kyis khyab par bsams na rgas dka' ba dang lus rgyas pa la sogs pa'i phan yon gsungs so/ /mthar gshegs su gsol ba ni/ dkyil 'khor la mchod bstod byas nas/ jo bos oṃ khyod kyis sems can don mdzad/ /zhes sogs kyi rgya skad kyis ye shes pa gshegs nas dam tshig pa rang la bsdu bar bshad pa ltar/

bod 'ga' zhig gis kyang bshad mod/ de ni yo ga'i cho ga bla med la 'chugs pa yin te/ de ltar byas na rang ye shes pa dang bral bar 'gyur ba'i phyir ro/ /des na/ sku'i rigs rnams sku rdo rje dang / gsung gi rigs rnams gsung rdo rje dang / thugs kyi rigs rnams thugs rdo rje la thim pa'i tshul gyis dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo rang la thim par gyur pas rdo rje gsum shin tu brtan par gyur/ zhes bya ste/ kun bzang las/ oṃ la sogs pas dkyil 'khor bsdus nas ni/ /sku la sogs pa brtan pa dag tu bya/ /zhes gsungs so/ /gsum pa 'jug la gshegs su gsol ba'i rjes su smon lam bya zhing / langs te 'gro ba la sogs pa'i spyod lam thams cad du rang la lha'i nga rgyal brtan po dang snod bcud rten dang brten pa snang stong sgyu ma'i rang bzhin du dran par bya'o/ /kha zas nang mchod ltar byin gyis rlabs shing oṃ āḥhūm̐ bzlas la snying kha'i maṃ yig lha thams cad kyi rang bzhin du gyur pa mchod pa'i bsam pas bza' zhing phyi nang gi sbyin sreg gis phung po'i bud shing bsregs pa dang / gzhan don thams cad kyang rgyal ba mnyes byed du shes pa dang / lus phyag rgya dang ngag thams cad sngags su shes te/ thabs shes khyad par can gyi sems kyis zin pa'i bya ba thams cad dge ba kho nar 'gyur bar bya ba dang / gal te dam tshig nyams na rang dam tshig rdo rje don grub du bsams pa'i snying khar zla ba la gnas pa'i sna tshogs rdo rje'i lte bar khaṃ ljang khu la sngags kyis bskor bar bsams nas/ oṃ āḥkhaṃ hūm̐ zhes pa mang du bzla' zhing / dbang rgyas bsdus blang ba sogs bya'o/ /khrus ni gong du brjod zin la/ nyal ba'i tshe na'ang dkyil 'khor la mchod bstod byas nas dkyil 'khor thams cad sngar bzhin snying kha'i maṃ la bsdus te 'gro ba la snying rje dang stong nyid kyi lta ba la bzhag pa'i sgo nas nyal zhing / ldang ba'i tshe na'ang byams sogs tshad med bzhi lha mo bzhir gyur pa'i glus sngar bzhin du bskul nas langs te/

slar yang snga ma lta bu'i tshul gyis thun bzhi'am drug du nyams su blang ngo / /thun mthar gtor ma ni 'di'i gzhung rnams su ma byung yang / a bha yas rdo rje phreng bar bshad pa ltar/ rang gi thugs kha'i maṃ yig gis khro bo bcu dang bcas pa'i bsrung ba'i 'khor lo yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du 'dus pa'i dkyil 'khor rten dang brten par bcas pa thams cad dang / de'i phyi rol du phyogs skyong bco lnga'am bcu dang / klu dang sems can thams cad bkug pa'i gzhal yas khang gi dbus su 'jam pa'i rdo rje yab yum/ shar du rnam snang nas byang sgor bgegs mthar byed kyi bar skad cig gis rdzogs par gyur/ phyi'i shar du rdo rje mtshon cha zhes sogs 'phags lugs la grags pa ltar/ yang na gong bzhin bskyed pa la sngar bzhin dbul lo/ /de nas chos skyong rdo rje nag po gdong bzhi pa sogs la'ang dbul/ de lta bu'i tshul gyis las dang po pa dang ye shes cung zad babs pa dang / ye shes la cung zad dbang ba'i cha shas bskyed rim mthar phyin pa na/ zhi sogs kyi las rab 'byams la 'jug cing / de rjes ye shes la yang dag par dbang ba rdzogs pa'i rim pa 'jam dpal gyi zhal gyi lung las gsung pa ltar nyams su blang bar bya ste gzhan du bshad par bya'o/ /gzhan yang bskyed rim gyi rnam bzhag dang yid ches pa'i lung rigs rgyas par ni/ 'di'i sgrub thabs kyi gtso bo bskyed rim gyi shing rta'i srol 'byed zla med par gyur pa slob dpon sangs rgyas ye shes zhabs kyis mdzad pa'i sgrub thabs kun bzang gi rnam bshad byed par 'dod par der bshad par bya'o// //rmad byung rgyal ba kun gyi ye shes sku/ /dmar ser gzhon nu'i mtshan dper shar ba gang / /dang po'i sangs rgyas de nyid mnyes pa'i thabs/ /bla med lam gyi dbus na mtho ba 'di/ /bshes gnyen 'ga' yis legs par bskul ba dang / /rang nyid tshul 'dir mchog tu gzhol ba'i mthus/

/dri med gzhung la rigs pas brtags nas sbyar/ /dge bas 'gro kun 'jam dbyangs thob par shog /'phags lam byis pas bshad pa'i rgyu las ni/ /cung zad nongs rnams 'phags pa'i tshogs la bshags/ /gsang chen bshad pa'i yul du ma gyur pa'i/ /mos pa dman pa rnams kyang dad thob shog /ces dpal gsang ba 'dus pa ye shes zhabs kyi lugs/ rje btsun 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyi sgrub thabs 'di ni/ mdo sngags kyi lung dang rtogs pa'i chos 'dzin cing / tshul 'di la lhag par mos pa'i dge ba'i bshes gnyen nam mkha' rin chen pa dang / bka' bcu pa bsam grub 'od zer ba gnyis kyis ring mo nas bskul zhing / spyi dang bye brag gi lam zab mo rnams la dad 'dun dang ldan pa'i dge ba'i bshes gnyen dbon po rgyal mtshan grags kyis gsar du nan tan gyis bskul nas/ bde bar gshegs pa'i gsung rab spyi dang khyad par lugs 'di la thos pa'i bag chags gsal zhing dpal ldan 'dus pa'i rnal 'byor la mchog tu gzhol ba'i dge slong lo tsā ba shes rab rin chen rgyal mtshan dpal bzang pos/ khro bo'i lo dbo'i zla ba'i mar ngo'i rdzogs pa gsum pa la dge 'phel chos 'khor sgang du sbyar ba rdzogs so// //phun tshogs snang chen zer 'gyed 'jam dbyangs kyi/ /sgrub thabs nyi ma'i mchog 'di chos 'khor ba'i/ /dge 'dun spyi sogs dad ldan rlung shugs dang / /bka' bcu dbang seng nye gnas dpal bzang bcas/ /rta bdun gyis drangs thub bstan nam mkhar shar/ /'dir 'bad bgyid dang gzhan yang 'gro kun gyi/ /ma rig mun pa myur du zhi gyur cing / /thub bstan pad+mo'i tshal chen rgyas gyur cig/ //rkos mkhan mkhas pa chos bzang yin// //maṅga laṃ// // PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 4 stag tshang lo tsā ba/ gsang 'dus 'jam rdor gyi mngon rtogs/ PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 3
